surfaces.name: Card Read / Check-In Screen
surfaces.description: The primary interface where staff reads a patient's card. Contains the read trigger, terminal status, and result area. This single surface handles the entire card read flow through its states (below).

surfaces.name: Patient Record View
surfaces.description: The patient's stored data after a successful read. Displays insurance details, coverage status, VSDM verification, WOP code, and care context. This is where read data "lands" and where staff reviews the patient profile.

states.name: Idle
states.trigger: No card action in progress
states.changes: Read trigger button active, terminal connection indicator visible

states.name: Reading
states.trigger: Staff initiates card read
states.changes: Loading/progress indicator replaces the trigger button

states.name: Success
states.trigger: Valid eGK read completes
states.changes: Result area shows patient name, insurer, read-in date (FK 4109). Date is non-editable.

states.name: Success + Coverage Warning
states.trigger: Valid read, but coverage dates are expired or not yet active
states.changes: Success state plus a warning banner showing coverage dates and insurer name

states.name: Success + Re-Read
states.trigger: Card re-read for patient already read this quarter
states.changes: Success state plus a confirmation notification showing previous date, new date, and count of updated billing records

states.name: Error: KVK Rejected
states.trigger: KVK detected for statutory patient (VKNR digits 3-5 < 800)
states.changes: Error message replaces result area. Explains KVK no longer accepted since 2015. "Show Card Data" action is available.

states.name: Error: KVK Rejected + Data Shown
states.trigger: Staff clicks "Show Card Data" on KVK error
states.changes: Error state expands to show all card fields as selectable, copyable text for manual transfer

states.name: Error: BPol KVK Blocked
states.trigger: KVK read attempted for BPol patient with existing eGK on file
states.changes: Error message explaining that an eGK is already on file and outdated KVK data cannot overwrite it

components.surface: Patient Record View, header or insurance section
components.name: VSDM Status Badge
components.description: Icon/badge showing online verification status. Visually distinct for "verified this quarter" vs. "stale/needs refresh." Shows FK 4136 value and timestamp.

components.name: Coverage Status Indicator
components.description: Shows current coverage validity (active, expired, not yet started) with start/end dates

components.surface: Patient Record View, insurance details section
components.name: WOP Field
components.description: Displays the WOP regional code. Editable as a manual fallback.

components.surface: Patient Record View, header or tab
components.name: Care Context Label
components.description: Indicates whether this record is Outpatient or Inpatient. Prevents cross-context data access.

components.name: Read-In Date (FK 4109)
components.description: System-generated, non-editable date showing when the card was last read

surfaces.name: Card Read / Check-In Screen (from Phase 1.1)
surfaces.description: Cost carrier resolution happens automatically during the card read. The result states below appear in the same result area as the Phase 1.1 success/error states. No new surface needed.

surfaces.name: Temporary Cost Carrier Form
surfaces.description: A data entry form for manually creating a temporary cost carrier master record when the IK is unknown. This is a new surface because the user is creating a new data entity, not just viewing a card read result.

states.name: Success + Billable
states.trigger: IK is valid, within validity period, cost carrier has active billing capability
states.changes: Result area shows resolved cost carrier name, billing VKNR, and KTAB. Normal flow, no warnings.

states.name: Success + Fusion Redirect
states.trigger: IK maps to a cost carrier that has merged into another
states.changes: Result area shows the absorbing carrier's name and VKNR. An info notice explains the merger: original IK retained for traceability, billing redirected to absorbing carrier.

states.name: Error: Carrier Dissolved
states.trigger: Cost carrier associated with the IK has been dissolved
states.changes: Error message replaces result area. Explains that the carrier no longer exists. Billing and form issuance are blocked. User must resolve before proceeding.

states.name: Warning: IK Expired + Override
states.trigger: IK is invalid or outside validity period
states.changes: Warning message with option to proceed anyway. If user overrides, billing capability is checked as in the normal flow (FALL 1).

states.name: Error: Carrier Not Permitted in Region
states.trigger: Cost carrier is not authorized in the practice's KV region
states.changes: Error message explaining the carrier cannot be billed in this KV area. Billing is blocked.

states.name: Warning: Unknown IK
states.trigger: IK is not found in the KT master data file
states.changes: Warning advising user to contact the KV association. Offers action to create a temporary cost carrier record (opens Surface 2).

states.name: Error: Billing Area Dissolved
states.trigger: The KTAB (billing area) of the cost carrier has been dissolved
states.changes: Error message explaining the billing area no longer exists. ADT billing via this KTAB is blocked. User must find an alternative billing path.

components.surface: Card Read / Check-In Screen, result area
components.name: Cost Carrier Summary
components.description: Displays resolved carrier name, billing VKNR, KTAB, and IK. Shown in all success states.

components.surface: Card Read / Check-In Screen, warning states
components.name: Override Action
components.description: Button or link allowing the user to proceed despite a warning (e.g., expired IK). Only shown on non-blocking warnings.

entries.phaseName: User Stories — Patient Matching & Insurance Changes

surfaces.name: Card Read / Check-In Screen (from Phase 1.1)
surfaces.description: Insurance change detection and Besondere Personengruppe alerts appear as additional states on the existing card read screen.

surfaces.name: Patient Match Review Panel
surfaces.description: A side-by-side comparison view shown when the system finds an existing patient record that matches or nearly matches the card data. The user must confirm whether to update the existing record, create a new one, or cancel. This is a new surface because the layout (two-column comparison + actions) is distinct from the card read result area.

states.name: Success + Insurance Change Detected
states.trigger: Card read for existing patient, but insurer/IK differs from stored record
states.changes: Success state plus an alert highlighting the insurance change. Shows old vs. new insurer. Staff must acknowledge before proceeding.

states.name: Success + KTAB Selection Required
states.trigger: Besondere Personengruppe (FK 4131) on card requires routing to a specific billing area
states.changes: Success state plus a prompt assisting the user in selecting the correct KTAB based on the person group code.

states.name: Success + AsylbLG Restriction Notice
states.trigger: Besondere Personengruppe 09 detected on card
states.changes: Success state plus an informational alert explaining that this patient has restricted healthcare entitlement under AsylbLG (Asylum Seekers Benefits Act).

states.name: Exact Match Found
states.trigger: Card data matches a stored patient record on key identifiers
states.changes: Side-by-side comparison showing card data vs. stored record. Actions: "Update Existing Record" or "Cancel Read."

states.name: Near Match Found
states.trigger: Card data partially matches one or more stored records (e.g., name matches but insurance number differs)
states.changes: Side-by-side comparison with differences highlighted. Actions: "Update Existing Record," "Create New Patient," or "Cancel Read."

components.surface: Card Read / Check-In Screen, result area
components.name: Insurance Change Alert
components.description: Highlights old vs. new insurer name, IK, and VKNR. Visually distinct from other warnings (e.g., amber with a "change" icon).

components.surface: Card Read / Check-In Screen, result area
components.name: KTAB Selector
components.description: Dropdown or selection control for choosing the correct billing area based on person group. May pre-select a recommended KTAB.

components.surface: Card Read / Check-In Screen, result area
components.name: AsylbLG Notice
components.description: Informational banner explaining restricted entitlement. Distinct from errors/warnings. Uses a neutral info style.

components.name: Record Comparison View
components.description: Two-column layout. Left: data from card. Right: data from stored record. Differences highlighted. Field-by-field comparison.

surfaces.name: Manual Patient Entry Form
surfaces.description: A full data entry form for registering a patient without a card read (Ersatzverfahren). Contains all fields from Tabelle 5. Used when the patient's card is unavailable, damaged, or for non-standard cost carriers.

surfaces.name: Cost Carrier Search Panel
surfaces.description: A search interface for finding cost carriers by IK, name, location, or VKNR. Opens from within the Manual Patient Entry Form when the user needs to look up a carrier. Could be a slide-out panel or modal.

surfaces.name: KIM Inbox
surfaces.description: A message inbox for receiving electronic replacement confirmations (eEB) via KIM. When an eEB arrives, the staff can view the coverage confirmation and apply it to a patient record.

surfaces.name: Temporary Cost Carrier Form (from Phase 1.2)
surfaces.description: Extended with required fields: VKNR, KTAB, print name (Bedruckungsname), and fee schedule (Gebuehrenordnung). Already introduced in Phase 1.2 (US-1.2.6), now with full field specification.

states.name: Standard Entry
states.trigger: User opens manual entry for a regular statutory patient
states.changes: All Tabelle 5 fields shown. FK 4131 defaults to '00', FK 4132 defaults to '00'. Gender field shows all four options.

states.name: SKT Entry
states.trigger: User selects a Sonstige Kostentrager (non-standard carrier)
states.changes: Additional kvx3 fields appear below the standard fields.

states.name: SKT Bundeswehr Entry
states.trigger: VKNR 79868 or 79869 entered/selected
states.changes: Military-specific fields and rules applied. Visual indicator that Bundeswehr rules are active.

states.name: PLZ Validation Error
states.trigger: User enters an invalid postal code
states.changes: Inline validation error on the PLZ field. Flags the code as not found in the PLZ master data.

states.name: eEB Received
states.trigger: An eEB message arrives via KIM
states.changes: New message appears in inbox with coverage confirmation details. Action to apply it to a patient record.

states.name: eEB Applied
states.trigger: Staff applies an eEB to a patient
states.changes: FK 4112 set to 1 (billing marker). Patient record updated to show coverage was confirmed via eEB, not card read.

components.name: Besondere Personengruppe Field (FK 4131)
components.description: Dropdown defaulting to '00' (no special group). Overridable.

components.name: DMP Indicator Field (FK 4132)
components.description: Dropdown defaulting to '00' (no DMP). Overridable. Displays human-readable DMP program name next to the code.

components.name: Gender Selector
components.description: Four options: male, female, diverse, indeterminate. Per PStG requirements.

components.name: Birth Date Field
components.description: Supports standard dates and special value ranges for unknown/estimated birth dates.

components.name: PLZ Field with Validation
components.description: Text input with live validation against PLZ master data. Shows error for invalid codes.

components.name: Cost Carrier Search Trigger
components.description: Button or link that opens the Cost Carrier Search Panel. Positioned near the carrier/IK fields.

components.name: eEB Billing Marker
components.description: Badge or indicator showing FK 4112 = 1, meaning coverage was confirmed via eEB rather than card read.

surfaces.name: Card Read / Check-In Screen (from Phase 1.1)
surfaces.description: Extended with a record type selector that appears after a first-in-quarter card read. Also shows a notice when a privately insured card is read.

surfaces.name: Schein / Billing Record View
surfaces.description: The main new surface. Shows a patient's billing records for the current quarter. Supports creating, viewing, and managing multiple 010x records. Different modes for TSS cases and referral cases. Holds TSS fields, referral fields, surcharge data, and case completion status.

surfaces.name: Quarter Transition Dashboard
surfaces.description: A view or notification area that manages the transition between billing quarters. Shows which cases are being closed, which carry forward, and any insurance/status changes that require record splitting.

surfaces.name: Patient Record View (from Phase 1.1)
surfaces.description: Extended with the ability to document name/address deviations from card data.

states.name: Record Type Selection
states.trigger: First card read for this patient in the current quarter
states.changes: After successful read, a record type selector appears (Satzart 0101-0104 or Scheinuntergruppe). Staff must select before proceeding.

states.name: Private Insurance Notice
states.trigger: Card for a privately insured patient is read
states.changes: Info notice replaces normal result area. Explains that this patient is privately insured and data will not flow into KVDT billing.

states.name: Standard Record
states.trigger: Staff creates/views a regular 010x billing record
states.changes: Standard billing record fields. No TSS or referral sections.

states.name: TSS Case
states.trigger: Record marked as TSS (FK 4103 set)
states.changes: TSS section appears: referral code, appointment date, referral source, surcharge category (A/B/C/D), case completion toggle. Vermittlungscode validated per v3.0.0 spec.

states.name: TSS Akutfall / HA-Vermittlungsfall
states.trigger: TSS case classified as acute or GP-mediated
states.changes: TSS section with modified surcharge rules and distinct billing handling for acute/GP cases.

states.name: Referral: Muster 6
states.trigger: Record created from a Muster 6 referral
states.changes: Referral section appears: referring physician, referral origin, referral diagnosis. Referral fields (FK 4219/4220/4241/4242) validated.

states.name: Referral: Muster 10 (Lab)
states.trigger: Record created from a Muster 10 lab referral
states.changes: Lab referral section: ordering physician, requested analyses, clinical context.

states.name: Referral: Muster 39 (Specialty)
states.trigger: Record created from a Muster 39 specialty referral
states.changes: Specialty referral section: target specialty, pre-authorization documentation.

states.name: Pseudo-Behandlungsfall (NaePa)
states.trigger: GOP 88194 pseudo-case created
states.changes: Simplified record for delegated services by non-physician practice assistants.

states.name: Quarter Closing
states.trigger: Current quarter ends
states.changes: List of records being closed, summary of carry-forward cases.

states.name: Insurance Change Split Required
states.trigger: Insurance change detected within quarter
states.changes: Shows affected records, old vs. new carrier, and the proposed split point.

states.name: Status Change Split Required
states.trigger: Person group or insured status change within quarter
states.changes: Shows affected records and proposed reclassification.

states.name: Official Data Update
states.trigger: VSDM update changes authoritative data mid-quarter
states.changes: Shows which records need updating with new official data.

components.name: Record Type Selector
components.description: Dropdown or button group for selecting Satzart 0101-0104 or Scheinuntergruppe. Appears on first-in-quarter card read.

components.name: TSS Section
components.description: Collapsible section with TSS-specific fields: Vermittlungscode, appointment date, referral source, surcharge category, case completion.

components.name: Referral Section
components.description: Collapsible section with referral-specific fields: referring physician, diagnosis, referral type, urgency, specialty. Fields vary by Muster type.

components.surface: Schein / Billing Record View, TSS section
components.name: Surcharge Calculator
components.description: Displays calculated surcharge category (A/B/C/D) based on days between referral and appointment. Read-only.

components.surface: Schein / Billing Record View, TSS section
components.name: Case Completion Toggle
components.description: Toggle or checkbox to mark a TSS case as completed (Fallabschluss).

components.name: Record Split Indicator
components.description: Visual marker showing that a record was split due to insurance or status change. Links to the sibling record.

components.name: Name/Address Deviation Fields
components.description: Editable fields for recording name/address that differs from card data. Official card data shown alongside for reference.

surfaces.name: EHIC Patient Entry Form
surfaces.description: A data entry form specifically for patients presenting a European Health Insurance Card instead of a German eGK. Captures EHIC-specific fields (country of origin, EHIC card number, institution details) and generates the required patient declaration form. Distinct from the standard Manual Entry Form (Phase 1.4) because the field set, validation rules, and output (declaration form) are different.

states.name: Data Entry
states.trigger: Staff selects "European Health Insurance Card" as the entry type
states.changes: EHIC-specific fields displayed: patient name, date of birth, EHIC card number, country of origin, issuing institution, card validity dates.

states.name: Declaration Preview
states.trigger: Staff completes data entry and requests declaration
states.changes: Preview of the generated patient declaration form, ready for printing and patient signature.

components.name: EHIC Country Selector
components.description: Dropdown of EU/EEA countries for selecting the patient's country of origin.

components.name: Declaration Form Generator
components.description: Action that generates the patient declaration document from the entered EHIC data. Output is a printable form.

surfaces.name: TE Form (Enrollment Declaration)
surfaces.description: Form for creating, viewing, and printing HZV and FAV enrollment declarations. Pre-fills patient data from the system. Handles both online and offline enrollment flows. Contains the signature/TE-Code verification dialog as a state.

surfaces.name: TE Overview List
surfaces.description: A list view showing all enrollment declarations with their statuses. Supports filtering and sorting. From Q2-26, HZV and FAV lists are unified at a single location. Provides quick access to individual declarations and transmission actions.

surfaces.name: Enrollment Settings
surfaces.description: Configuration view for setting the enrollment method (online vs. offline) per BSNR and per contract. Accessible from practice settings.

states.name: Created (Erzeugt)
states.trigger: Staff creates a new enrollment declaration
states.changes: Form is fully editable. Patient data pre-filled from system. Print and Save actions available.

states.name: Created + Missing Data Warning
states.trigger: Required therapy/diagnosis data missing when print is attempted
states.changes: Warning banner appears before printing, listing missing fields. Staff must review and complete data.

states.name: Created + Offline Hint
states.trigger: Offline enrollment procedure applies
states.changes: Info hint explains offline enrollment requirements and limitations during the print flow.

states.name: Printed (Gedruckt)
states.trigger: Staff prints the declaration
states.changes: Form becomes read-only. Signature/TE-Code verification action becomes available. Status indicator updates.

states.name: Signature & TE-Code Dialog (HZV)
states.trigger: Staff opens verification on a Printed or Error HZV declaration
states.changes: Dialog overlay with: Signature 1 (YES/NO, default NO, with mandatory hint text), Signature 2 (YES/NO, default NO, with mandatory hint text), TE-Code input (exactly 4 digits). Completion requires Signature 1 = YES and TE-Code match. Shows mismatch warning or confirmation message.

states.name: Signature & TE-Code Dialog (FAV)
states.trigger: Staff opens verification on a Printed or Error FAV declaration
states.changes: Dialog overlay with: Signature (YES/NO, default NO, with mandatory hint text), TE-Code input (exactly 4 digits). Completion requires Signature = YES and TE-Code match. Shows mismatch warning or confirmation message.

states.name: Error (Fehlerhaft)
states.trigger: Transmission failed
states.changes: Form read-only. Error details shown. Retry transmission and signature/TE-Code verification available.

states.name: Successful (Erfolgreich)
states.trigger: Transmission succeeded
states.changes: Form read-only. Success indicator. TE identifier displayed. Declaration cannot be deleted or re-transmitted. For FAV: participation auto-activated.

states.name: HZV List
states.trigger: User views HZV declarations
states.changes: List of HZV enrollment declarations with status, patient name, dates. Filter and sort controls.

states.name: FAV List
states.trigger: User views FAV declarations
states.changes: List of FAV enrollment declarations with status, patient name, dates. Filter and sort controls.

states.name: Unified List
states.trigger: User views all declarations (Q2-26+)
states.changes: Combined HZV and FAV list at a single location with type filter.

states.name: Unsent Notification
states.trigger: Daily check finds untransmitted declarations
states.changes: Notification badge or banner showing count of unsent declarations. Links to filtered list.

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Shows current status: Created, Printed, Error, Successful. Color-coded (e.g., gray/blue/red/green).

components.name: Print Action
components.description: Triggers printing of the enrollment declaration. HZV prints DIN A4. FAV prints full template from AKA base data (patient copy + physician form). Accessible from patient context.

components.name: Save Action
components.description: Saves declaration as PDF/data record. Stores TE-Code validation status and signature confirmation alongside. Manual trigger only.

components.name: Offline Receipt Print
components.description: Prints DIN A6 enrollment receipt for offline enrollment.

components.name: Offline Declaration Print
components.description: Prints two-sided DIN A4 offline enrollment form per AKA base data template.

components.name: Transmit Action
components.description: Sends declaration to HPM. Checks prerequisites (signatures, mandatory fields, transmittable status). Blocked for already-successful declarations.

components.name: Delete Action
components.description: Deletes declaration. Only available for Created, Printed, or Error status. Blocked for Successful.

components.name: TE Identifier Display
components.description: Shows the unique identifier returned by HPM after successful transmission. Persisted for reference.

components.name: Enrollment Method Selector
components.description: Toggle or radio group: Online vs. Offline enrollment, per BSNR and per contract. Selection persists across updates.

surfaces.name: Patient Record View (from Phase 1.1)
surfaces.description: Extended with insurance change alerts, re-enrollment notices, and a persistent display of eligible contracts. These appear automatically when opening a patient record.

surfaces.name: Participation Management View
surfaces.description: A dedicated view showing all contract participations for a patient. Displays statuses, supports lifecycle actions (request, activate, end, reverse, cancel), and enforces prerequisites. Accessible from the patient context.

states.name: Insurance Change Alert
states.trigger: Patient record opened and insurance has changed since last visit
states.changes: Alert banner at top of patient record highlighting the insurance change. Prompts re-enrollment.

states.name: Re-Enrollment Notice
states.trigger: Insurance change detected for a patient with active HZV/FAV participation
states.changes: Notice explaining that the patient needs a new enrollment declaration under the new insurer to continue participating. Action to create new TE.

states.name: No Participations
states.trigger: Patient has no contract participations
states.changes: Empty state with "Request Participation" action and list of eligible contracts.

states.name: Active Participations
states.trigger: Patient has one or more active participations
states.changes: List of participations with status badges. Lifecycle actions available per participation.

states.name: Module Contract Blocked
states.trigger: Staff tries to activate module contract without active main contract
states.changes: Error/warning explaining the main contract must be active before module contracts can be activated.

states.name: Activation Date Change Warning
states.trigger: Staff changes the activation date of a participation
states.changes: Warning dialog explaining billing period implications of the date change.

states.name: Direct Activation Warning
states.trigger: Staff activates without prior request
states.changes: Warning dialog explaining this is a non-standard procedure (e.g., retroactive enrollment or data correction).

components.name: Eligible Contracts Display
components.description: Persistent, automatic display of all contracts the patient qualifies for based on their Kassen-IK, practice enrollment, and contract region. Shown without user action.

components.name: Participation Status Badge
components.description: Color-coded badge showing current status: Requested, Active, Ended, Reversed, Cancelled.

components.name: Lifecycle Action Buttons
components.description: Context-sensitive actions per participation: Activate, End, Reverse Termination, Cancel. Available actions depend on current status.

components.surface: Participation Management View / Patient Record View
components.name: FAV Status Check
components.description: Quick-check indicator showing whether a patient is actively enrolled in FAV. Verifiable before documenting FAV services.

components.name: Specialist Search Link
components.description: External link to medi-arztsuche.de for specialist search. Positioned near referral creation.

components.name: Therapy Facilities Link
components.description: External link to AOK therapy facility information. Positioned near relevant document retrieval.

entries.phaseName: User Stories — HZV/FAV Import & Data Synchronization

surfaces.name: PTV Import Wizard
surfaces.description: A multi-step workflow for importing a patient participant directory (PTV). Steps: file selection, pre-import validation summary, user confirmation, import execution, and protocol display.

surfaces.name: Import Protocol View
surfaces.description: A detailed report displayed after import. Shows import metadata, changed patients (sorted by status then name), special notifications, not-found patients, and master data conflicts. Must be printable. Reviewable after the import (not just a one-time display).

surfaces.name: ICode Management View
surfaces.description: An administrative screen for managing patient identification codes (ICodes) per quarter. Allows viewing, assigning, and maintaining ICodes for data synchronization.

states.name: Step 1: File Selection
states.trigger: Staff initiates PTV import
states.changes: File picker or source selector for the participant directory file.

states.name: Step 2: Pre-Import Validation
states.trigger: File loaded and validated
states.changes: Summary showing three categories: Normal participation notifications (unchanged + newly reported), Special participation notifications, Not-found patients. Each category with counts and patient lists.

states.name: Step 3: Confirmation
states.trigger: Validation complete
states.changes: Import summary with content overview. Staff must confirm before proceeding. Clear indication of what will be auto-imported vs. what requires manual action.

states.name: Step 4: Importing
states.trigger: Staff confirms import
states.changes: Progress indicator. Standard import rules applied automatically for normal notifications. Exceptions logged.

states.name: Step 5: Protocol
states.trigger: Import complete
states.changes: Redirects to Import Protocol View (Surface 2).

states.name: Changed Patients Section
states.trigger: Import completed with changes
states.changes: List of patients where data changed, sorted by status (Aktiviert > Beendet > Beantragt > Abgelehnt) then by name. Changed values visually highlighted.

states.name: Special Notifications Section
states.trigger: Import found special participation notifications
states.changes: List of patients with non-standard notifications. Not auto-imported. Staff can manually transfer data.

states.name: Not-Found Patients Section
states.trigger: Import found patients not in the system
states.changes: List of patients from the PTV that could not be matched to any patient in the system.

states.name: Master Data Conflicts Section
states.trigger: Import found data discrepancies
states.changes: Separate category showing patients where last name, first name, or gender differs between PTV and system (after ignoring case, whitespace, umlaut, and sharp-s variations). Shows both values side by side. Never auto-resolved.

components.name: Import Metadata Header
components.description: Shows: contract name, contract partner (name + VP-ID), quarter/year, importing user, import type (Standardimport), date and time.

components.name: Patient Count Summary
components.description: Total number of enrolled patients after import.

components.surface: Import Protocol View, changed patients list
components.name: Changed Value Highlight
components.description: Visual highlighting of values that changed during import. Must work in both screen view and print.

components.surface: Import Protocol View, special notifications section
components.name: Manual Transfer Action
components.description: Action to manually transfer data for special notifications or not-found patients that were not auto-imported.

components.name: Conflict Display
components.description: Side-by-side display of conflicting values from PTV and system. No auto-resolve action.

components.name: ICode Table
components.description: Table of ICodes per quarter. Columns: patient, ICode, quarter, status. Supports add/edit/delete.

entries.phaseName: Phase 2A.1 User Stories — Acute Diagnosis Entry

surfaces.name: Patient Record View (from Phase 1.1)
surfaces.description: Extended with a timeline view and textbox input for clinical entries including diagnoses. Diagnoses appear as entries in the timeline. The textbox is the primary input mechanism for adding diagnoses.

states.name: ICD Code Entry
states.trigger: Physician types an ICD code or search term into the textbox
states.changes: Autocomplete/search results appear below the textbox showing matching ICD codes with their SDICD Klartext (plain-text descriptions).

states.name: Diagnosensicherheit Selection
states.trigger: Physician selects an ICD code from search results
states.changes: A mandatory selector appears for diagnostic certainty (V/G/A/Z). No option is pre-selected. The physician cannot proceed without choosing one.

states.name: Additional Attributes
states.trigger: Diagnosensicherheit selected for a code that requires laterality or supports explanatory text
states.changes: Additional fields appear: Seitenlokalisation (R/L/B) if applicable, Erlaeuterungstext (free text), and Ausnahmetatbestand (exception indicator).

states.name: Diagnosis Added
states.trigger: Physician confirms the diagnosis entry
states.changes: The diagnosis appears as a new entry in the timeline, showing the ICD code, Klartext, Diagnosensicherheit badge, and any additional attributes.

components.name: Timeline Entry Textbox
components.description: The primary input for clinical entries. When typing ICD codes or search terms, triggers ICD search against SDICD.

components.name: ICD Search Results
components.description: Shows matching ICD codes with SDICD Klartext. Supports code entry, free-text search, and user-defined shortcuts. Results include the full code and its plain-text description.

components.name: Diagnosensicherheit Selector
components.description: Four-option selector: V (Verdacht/suspected), G (Gesichert/confirmed), A (Ausschluss/excluded), Z (Zustand nach/status post). No default. Required.

components.name: Seitenlokalisation Selector
components.description: Three-option selector: R (right), L (left), B (bilateral). Only shown when the ICD code requires laterality.

components.name: Erlaeuterungstext Field
components.description: Free-text input for explanatory text accompanying the diagnosis.

components.name: Ausnahmetatbestand Toggle
components.description: Toggle or checkbox for marking an exception condition.

components.name: Diagnosis Timeline Entry
components.description: A completed diagnosis entry showing: ICD code, Klartext, Diagnosensicherheit badge (color-coded: V=yellow, G=green, A=red, Z=blue), laterality if applicable, and explanatory text if provided. Labeled as "Akutdiagnose."

entries.phaseName: Phase 2A.2 User Stories — Dauerdiagnosen & Anamnestische Diagnosen

surfaces.name: Patient Record View (from Phase 1.1)
surfaces.description: Extended with a persistent sidebar for Dauerdiagnosen and Anamnestische Diagnosen. These are always visible alongside the timeline. Adoption into the current quarter creates a new timeline entry.

states.name: Adoption Confirmation
states.trigger: Physician clicks "Adopt" on a Dauerdiagnose or Anamnestische Diagnose in the sidebar
states.changes: An inline confirmation panel appears showing the diagnosis with its current Diagnosensicherheit pre-filled but editable. Physician must actively confirm or change the certainty. Additional attribute fields (laterality, explanatory text, exception) appear if applicable.

states.name: Digit Completion Prompt
states.trigger: Adopted code can be specified to 4th or 5th digit
states.changes: A prompt appears within the adoption panel showing available sub-codes and indicating whether completion is optional or mandatory.

states.name: Z01.7 Exemption Hint
states.trigger: Code Z01.7 is being adopted
states.changes: An informational notice appears explaining the laboratory exemption rule.

states.name: Adopted
states.trigger: Physician confirms adoption
states.changes: A new timeline entry appears labeled "Behandlungsdiagnose (from Dauerdiagnose)" or "(from Anamnestische Diagnose)." The sidebar entry shows an indicator that it has been adopted for the current quarter.

components.name: Dauerdiagnosen Sidebar Section
components.description: Persistent list of all chronic diagnoses. Each entry shows: ICD code, Klartext, Diagnosensicherheit badge. Visually distinct from acute diagnoses (e.g., different background, icon, or border). Labeled "Dauerdiagnosen." Each entry has an "Adopt" action.

components.surface: Patient Record View, sidebar, below Dauerdiagnosen
components.name: Anamnestische Diagnosen Sidebar Section
components.description: Persistent list of all historical diagnoses. Same display format as Dauerdiagnosen but with distinct label "Anamnestische Diagnosen" and different visual styling. Each entry has an "Adopt" action.

components.surface: Inline (expands from sidebar entry or appears as popover)
components.name: Adoption Panel
components.description: Shows the diagnosis being adopted with: Diagnosensicherheit selector (pre-filled from stored value but editable), Seitenlokalisation (if applicable), Erlaeuterungstext, Ausnahmetatbestand. "Confirm Adoption" and "Cancel" actions.

components.name: Digit Completion Prompt
components.description: Shows available 4th/5th digit sub-codes when the current code can be further specified. Indicates whether completion is optional or mandatory.

components.name: Quarter Adoption Indicator
components.description: Badge or icon on sidebar entries that have already been adopted in the current quarter. Prevents confusion about which diagnoses are active for billing.

components.name: Pool Filter
components.description: Filter controls to limit which Dauerdiagnosen or Anamnestische Diagnosen are shown (e.g., by specialty, frequency). Reduces cognitive load for patients with many chronic/historical diagnoses.

entries.phaseName: Phase 2A.3 User Stories — SDICD Master Data Validation

surfaces.name: Patient Record View (from Phase 1.1)
surfaces.description: No new surface. All validation feedback appears inline within the diagnosis entry textbox, the search results dropdown, and the adoption panel (Phase 2A.2).

states.name: Code Rejected: Non-Existent
states.trigger: Physician enters/selects a code not in SDICD
states.changes: Inline error message below the textbox: "Code does not exist in ICD-10-GM." Entry is blocked.

states.name: Code Rejected: Non-Billable
states.trigger: Physician selects a chapter heading or group label
states.changes: Inline error message: "This code is a structural heading and cannot be used as a diagnosis." Entry is blocked. In search results, non-billable codes appear greyed out with a label explaining why.

states.name: Code Rejected: Placeholder
states.trigger: Physician selects a placeholder code with no content
states.changes: Inline error message: "This code has no clinical content and cannot be used." Entry is blocked. In search results, placeholder codes are either hidden or greyed out.

states.name: Code Rejected: Unpaired Secondary
states.trigger: Physician enters a Stern (*) or Ausrufezeichen (!) code without a primary Kreuz code
states.changes: Inline error message: "This secondary code requires a primary (dagger) code. Enter the primary code first." Entry is blocked until pairing is satisfied.

states.name: Warning: Gender Mismatch
states.trigger: Code has a gender reference that conflicts with patient's recorded gender
states.changes: Non-blocking warning banner below the textbox: "This code is typically associated with [male/female] patients. The current patient is recorded as [gender]. Please verify." Physician can dismiss and proceed.

states.name: Warning: Age Mismatch
states.trigger: Code has an age reference that conflicts with patient's age
states.changes: Non-blocking warning banner: "This code is typically used for [age group]. The patient is [age]. Please verify." Physician can dismiss and proceed.

states.name: Hint: Rare in Central Europe
states.trigger: Code is flagged as rare in Central Europe in SDICD
states.changes: Non-blocking info hint: "This diagnosis is rare in Central Europe. Please verify." Subtle styling, dismissible.

states.name: Alert: IfSG Reporting Obligation
states.trigger: Code is associated with IfSG reporting requirement
states.changes: Prominent non-blocking alert: "This diagnosis triggers a mandatory reporting obligation under the Infection Protection Act (IfSG)." Optionally includes billing special rules hint.

states.name: Warning: Unsuitable as Dauerdiagnose
states.trigger: Code flagged as unsuitable for Dauerdiagnose is being assigned as one
states.changes: Non-blocking warning in the Dauerdiagnosen sidebar section: "This code represents an acute condition and is not suitable as a Dauerdiagnose." Physician can override.

states.name: Search: Favorites Tab Active
states.trigger: Physician switches to Favorites tab in search dropdown
states.changes: Search results area switches from full SDICD search results to the physician's personal or specialty favorites list. Same result row format.

components.name: Validation Message (Error)
components.description: Red-styled message for blocking rejections (non-existent, non-billable, placeholder, unpaired secondary). Prevents the code from being saved. Includes a brief explanation of why.

components.name: Validation Message (Warning)
components.description: Amber-styled non-blocking message for plausibility checks (gender, age, Dauerdiagnose suitability). Includes a "Dismiss" or "Proceed anyway" action.

components.name: Validation Message (Info Hint)
components.description: Neutral/blue-styled non-blocking hint for rare disease and IfSG alerts. Dismissible. Less prominent than warnings.

components.name: Search Results Dropdown (extended)
components.description: Extended from Phase 2A.1. Now includes: tab bar ("Search" / "Favorites"), greyed-out non-billable/placeholder codes with explanatory labels, free-text search across code titles, Inklusiva, and Exklusiva.

components.name: Favorites Tab
components.description: A tab showing the physician's personal or specialty-specific favorite ICD codes. Same row format as search results. Codes can be added/removed from favorites via a star/bookmark icon on each search result row.

components.name: Non-Billable Code Row
components.description: Greyed-out row for chapter headings, group labels, and placeholder codes. Shows the code and title but is not selectable. Includes a small label ("Chapter heading", "Group label", or "No content") explaining why.

components.surface: Within search results dropdown and diagnosis textbox area
components.name: Kreuz-Stern Pairing Indicator
components.description: Visual indicator on secondary codes (* / !) showing they require a primary code. In search results, these rows show a pairing icon or label. When selected, the system prompts for the primary code.

components.name: SDICD Version Indicator
components.description: Displays the currently active SDICD version and quarter. Visible to practice administrators. Not part of daily physician workflow.

entries.phaseName: Phase 2A.4 User Stories — SDVA Coding Instructions

surfaces.name: Coding Instructions Browser
surfaces.description: A standalone reference view for browsing the full SDVA document. Physicians open this independently of any specific diagnosis entry context. Contains a navigable table of contents, searchable content area, and change highlighting for annual updates.

surfaces.name: Patient Record View (from Phase 1.1)
surfaces.description: Extended with a context-sensitive coding instruction panel accessible from the diagnosis entry area. No new artboard needed, but a new interaction point.

states.name: Coding Instruction Popover
states.trigger: Physician clicks a "Coding guidance" icon/link on a diagnosis entry or search result
states.changes: A popover or slide-out panel appears showing the SDVA instruction relevant to the selected ICD code. Includes the instruction text exactly as provided by KBV. A link to open the full browser is included.

states.name: Change Highlights Active
states.trigger: Physician toggles "Show changes" in the Coding Instructions Browser
states.changes: Modified sections are visually highlighted (e.g., yellow background, change markers in the margin). A change summary or changelog section becomes visible.

components.surface: Diagnosis search result rows, diagnosis textbox area, timeline diagnosis entries
components.name: Coding Guidance Icon
components.description: A small icon (e.g., book, info-circle) that opens the context-sensitive coding instruction for that code. Present wherever an ICD code is displayed.

components.surface: Popover or slide-out from Patient Record View
components.name: Context Instruction Panel
components.description: Displays the SDVA instruction text for a specific code. Read-only. Shows the instruction exactly as provided by KBV. Includes a "Open full browser" link.

components.name: Table of Contents
components.description: Navigable TOC of the SDVA document. Allows jumping to specific chapters or sections. Sections with annual changes are marked.

components.name: Content Area
components.description: The full text of the SDVA. Supports scrolling, search-within-document, and change highlighting.

components.name: Change Markers
components.description: Visual indicators on sections that changed in the current year's SDVA version. Could be margin icons, background highlighting, or a "Changed" badge.

components.surface: Coding Instructions Browser header, Settings/Admin area
components.name: SDVA Version Indicator
components.description: Shows the currently active SDVA version and year.

entries.phaseName: Phase 2A.5 User Stories — SDKRW Coding Rule Engine

surfaces.name: Rule Violation Overview
surfaces.description: A dedicated view listing all detected coding rule violations for a patient's treatment case(s). Each violation shows the affected diagnosis, rule text, hint, and proposed correction (DELETE/REPLACE/ADD). The physician works through violations one by one, accepting or rejecting each correction.

surfaces.name: Coding Rule Settings
surfaces.description: A settings panel where the physician or admin configures rule execution behavior: enable/disable per-case validation, enable/disable cross-quarter validation, set execution timing (on entry, on case closure, on demand).

surfaces.name: Patient Record View (from Phase 1.1)
surfaces.description: Extended with inline violation indicators on diagnosis entries that triggered coding rules. A badge or link on the patient record provides access to the Rule Violation Overview.

states.name: Violations Detected
states.trigger: Rule engine completes execution and finds violations
states.changes: A violation count badge appears on the patient record. The Rule Violation Overview becomes accessible. Timeline diagnosis entries with violations show an inline warning indicator.

states.name: No Violations
states.trigger: Rule engine completes execution with no issues
states.changes: A brief confirmation message: "No coding violations found." No further action required.

states.name: Correction Pending
states.trigger: Physician is reviewing a specific violation in the overview
states.changes: The violation row expands or highlights, showing the full rule text, hint, and correction proposal. Accept/Reject actions are visible. The correction type (DELETE/REPLACE/ADD) is clearly labeled.

states.name: Correction Accepted
states.trigger: Physician clicks "Accept" on a correction
states.changes: The violation is marked as resolved. The diagnosis is updated (deleted, replaced, or complementary code added). The row shows a "Resolved" status.

states.name: Correction Rejected
states.trigger: Physician clicks "Reject" on a correction
states.changes: The violation is marked as dismissed. The diagnosis remains unchanged. The row shows a "Dismissed" status.

states.name: Execution Aborted
states.trigger: Physician clicks "Abort" during rule processing
states.changes: Processing stops. Already accepted corrections are preserved. Remaining violations are left unreviewed. A message confirms: "Execution stopped. Previous corrections retained."

states.name: Rule Update Notification
states.trigger: SDKRW version is updated at quarter start
states.changes: A notification appears (banner or dialog) listing new, modified, and removed rules. Dismissible after review.

components.surface: Patient Record View, header or toolbar area
components.name: Violation Count Badge
components.description: Shows the number of unresolved coding violations for the current case. Clicking navigates to the Rule Violation Overview.

components.name: Violation Row
components.description: One row per violation. Shows: affected ICD code + description, rule ID, rule hint text, correction type label (DELETE/REPLACE/ADD), proposed correction detail, and Accept/Reject actions. Expandable to show full rule text.

components.name: Correction Type Badge
components.description: A colored label indicating the correction type. DELETE (red), REPLACE (amber), ADD (blue/green). Helps the physician quickly scan the severity and nature of each violation.

components.surface: Inline within violation row or as a popover
components.name: Confirmation Dialog
components.description: When the physician clicks "Accept," a brief confirmation shows exactly what will change (e.g., "Delete diagnosis E11.9?" or "Replace E11.9 with E11.65?"). Requires a second click to execute.

components.name: Abort Button
components.description: Stops rule engine processing. Preserves already-accepted corrections. Clearly labeled to avoid confusion with "Reject all."

components.surface: Timeline diagnosis entries on Patient Record View
components.name: Inline Violation Indicator
components.description: A small warning icon on diagnosis entries that have associated rule violations. Clicking navigates to the relevant violation in the overview.

components.name: Execution Timing Selector
components.description: Controls for when per-case rules run: "On diagnosis entry," "On case closure," "On demand only." Similar controls for cross-quarter scope.

components.surface: Notification banner or Coding Rule Settings
components.name: Rule Change Summary
components.description: Lists new, modified, and removed rules after an SDKRW update. Each entry shows the rule ID and a brief description of the change.

components.surface: Coding Rule Settings, Rule Violation Overview header
components.name: SDKRW Version Indicator
components.description: Displays the currently active SDKRW version and quarter.

entries.phaseName: Phase 2A.6 User Stories — HZV/FAV Diagnosis Rules

surfaces.name: Multimorbidity Surcharge Patient List
surfaces.description: A batch report view showing patients with 3+ disease patterns for the multimorbidity surcharge (P4). Displays patient details, matched disease patterns, and highlighting for patients with 1 or 2 P4 services. Printable. Accessible from billing validation run.

surfaces.name: Schein/Billing Record View (from Phase 1.5)
surfaces.description: Extended with HZV/FAV diagnosis quarter display, carry-forward review, and disease pattern check access. HZV/FAV diagnoses for the current quarter are visible and manageable here.

surfaces.name: Patient Record View (from Phase 1.1)
surfaces.description: Existing diagnosis entry area receives HZV/FAV-specific warnings: terminal code prompts, acute-as-permanent warnings, repeated suspected diagnosis warnings.

states.name: Carry-Forward Review
states.trigger: New quarter starts for an HZV/FAV patient
states.changes: All Dauerdiagnosen are initially carried forward. A review panel shows each carried diagnosis with confirm/remove actions. Physician must review before HZV/FAV billing is finalized.

states.name: Terminal Code Prompt
states.trigger: Physician enters a non-terminal ICD code
states.changes: A prompt appears showing available sub-codes. Guides the physician to select the most specific terminal code. Non-blocking warning initially, enforcement on save.

states.name: Acute-as-Permanent Warning
states.trigger: Code flagged as acute is stored/carried as Dauerdiagnose
states.changes: Amber warning: "This code represents an acute condition and may not be suitable as a Dauerdiagnose." Configurable per contract rules.

states.name: Repeated Suspected Diagnosis Warning
states.trigger: Same code documented as suspected (V) in both current and previous quarter
states.changes: Warning: "This diagnosis was already documented as suspected last quarter. Consider confirming or excluding."

states.name: Disease Pattern Result — Matches Found
states.trigger: Single-patient disease pattern check returns 1-18 groups
states.changes: Info panel showing patient name, DOB, and matched disease patterns (clear-text names, line-by-line).

states.name: Disease Pattern Result — No Matches
states.trigger: Single-patient check returns 0 groups
states.changes: Message: "Fuer den Patienten [NAME], [GEBURTSDATUM] liegen keine P4-relevanten Diagnosen vor."

states.name: Surcharge List — Highlighted Rows
states.trigger: Multimorbidity report generated
states.changes: Patients with exactly 1 P4 service are highlighted in one style. Patients with exactly 2 P4 services are highlighted in a different, distinguishable style. Legend explains the highlighting.

components.name: Carry-Forward Review Panel
components.description: List of all Dauerdiagnosen carried into the new quarter. Each row shows: ICD code, Klartext, Diagnosensicherheit. Actions: Confirm (keep) or Remove (exclude from this quarter).

components.surface: Patient Record View, diagnosis entry area
components.name: Terminal Code Selector
components.description: When a non-terminal code is entered, expands to show available sub-codes in a dropdown or inline list. Guides selection of the most specific code.

components.surface: Patient Record View / Carry-Forward Review Panel
components.name: Acute-as-Permanent Warning Banner
components.description: Amber inline warning on Dauerdiagnosen with acute-only codes. Configurable per HZV/FAV contract rules. Dismissible but logged.

components.surface: Patient Record View, diagnosis entry area
components.name: Repeated Suspected Warning Banner
components.description: Amber warning when a code with Diagnosensicherheit V matches a suspected diagnosis from the previous quarter. Suggests confirmation or exclusion.

components.surface: Schein/Billing Record View or Patient Record, prominent location
components.name: Disease Pattern Check Button
components.description: A button labeled "Pruefung auf Multimorbiditaet nach P4" that triggers the single-patient disease pattern check. Available for all actively participating HZV/FAV patients.

components.surface: Inline panel or dialog on patient record
components.name: Disease Pattern Result Panel
components.description: Displays matched disease pattern groups as clear-text names. Format: patient name, DOB, semicolon-separated disease patterns with line breaks. Or a table with first name, last name, patient number, DOB, disease patterns.

components.name: Patient Row (Surcharge List)
components.description: One row per patient with 3+ disease patterns. Columns: first name, last name, patient number, DOB, disease patterns (clear-text, semicolon-separated). Two highlight styles for 1-P4-service and 2-P4-service patients. Patient name links to patient record for diagnosis adjustment.

components.surface: Multimorbidity Surcharge Patient List, header or footer
components.name: Surcharge List Legend
components.description: Explains the two highlight styles (1 P4 service vs. 2 P4 services).

components.name: Surcharge List Disclaimer
components.description: Mandatory closing text about the report scope (unbilled services only, no guarantee of actual reimbursement).

entries.phaseName: Phase 2B.1 User Stories — Core Service Entry

surfaces.name: Schein/Billing Record View (from Phase 1.5)
surfaces.description: Extended with a service documentation section. Treatment days are listed chronologically, each containing the GNRs (service codes) documented that day. This is the primary workspace for entering, reviewing, and managing billed services.

states.name: Day Separation Prompt
states.trigger: Physician triggers Tagtrennung for services spanning midnight
states.changes: A time capture input appears, requiring the physician to enter the separation time. The service list splits into two treatment days at the specified boundary.

states.name: Fee Rule Violation
states.trigger: Automatic fee rule check detects an exclusion, frequency limit, or bundling conflict
states.changes: An inline warning or error appears on the affected GNR: explains the rule violation (e.g., "This service is excluded when billed with [other GNR]" or "Frequency limit reached for this quarter").

states.name: Service Chain Expansion
states.trigger: Physician selects a service chain
states.changes: Multiple GNRs are proposed as a group. Each individual GNR requires separate confirmation before being added to the treatment day.

states.name: Justification Text Entry
states.trigger: Physician adds or edits a justification text for a GNR
states.changes: A text field expands below or beside the GNR entry, allowing free-text input for the medical necessity justification.

components.name: Treatment Day Group
components.description: A collapsible group header showing the treatment date. Below it: all GNRs documented on that day, sorted chronologically. Days are listed in ascending order.

components.name: GNR Entry Row
components.description: One row per service code. Shows: GNR number, description (Leistungsbezeichnung), billing pathway marker if applicable, justification text indicator if present. Actions: edit, delete, add justification.

components.surface: Top of service section or within a Treatment Day Group
components.name: GNR Input
components.description: A textbox or search field for entering a new GNR by code or keyword. Triggers fee rule validation on entry.

components.name: Justification Text Field
components.description: Free-text input for the Begruendungstext. Shown when the physician adds a justification or when the GNR requires one. Saved per GNR.

components.surface: Service section toolbar or between Treatment Day Groups
components.name: Tagtrennung Action
components.description: An explicit button or action to insert a day boundary with time capture. Not automatic. Labeled "Tagtrennung" with a time input field.

components.name: Billing Pathway Marker
components.description: A small badge or label indicating the billing pathway: regular KV, selective contract, TSS, etc. Physician can set or change the marking.

components.name: Fee Rule Indicator
components.description: An icon or inline message when a fee rule applies to the GNR (exclusion, frequency limit, bundling). Color-coded: error for hard blocks, warning for soft limits.

components.name: Service Chain Selector
components.description: A dropdown or autocomplete that offers predefined service chains. Selecting a chain proposes multiple GNRs. Each must be individually confirmed (Einzelquittierung) before being added.

surfaces.name: Schein/Billing Record View (from Phase 1.5)
surfaces.description: Extended with billing justification fields on GNR entries. Visit-type services gain urgency/location/zone fields. Genetic testing services gain HGNC gene symbol input. All services gain a free-text disease type fallback field.

states.name: Visit Justification Fields Shown
states.trigger: Physician enters a visit-type GNR (Besuch)
states.changes: Additional fields appear on the GNR row: urgency marker (DKM) dropdown, visit location field, zone classification selector.

states.name: Gene Symbol Input Active
states.trigger: Physician enters a genetic testing GNR
states.changes: An HGNC gene symbol input field appears on the GNR row, supporting single symbols or symbol chains. Autocomplete from HGNC key table.

states.name: Gene Symbol Validation Error
states.trigger: Invalid or unrecognized gene symbol entered
states.changes: Inline error on the gene symbol field: "Gene symbol not found in HGNC key table." Entry is blocked until corrected.

states.name: Free-Text Fallback Active
states.trigger: Physician opens the disease type free-text field on any GNR
states.changes: A free-text input (FK 5079) expands below the GNR row for entering the Art der Erkrankung when structured coding is insufficient.

components.surface: Expandable section on visit-type GNR rows
components.name: Visit Justification Panel
components.description: Contains: DKM (urgency marker) dropdown, visit location text field, zone classification selector. Appears only for visit-type service codes.

components.name: DKM Selector
components.description: Dropdown for selecting the urgency classification of the visit. Options defined by KVDT key tables.

components.name: HGNC Gene Symbol Input
components.description: An input field with autocomplete for entering HGNC gene symbols. Supports chaining multiple symbols (comma or semicolon-separated). Validates each symbol against the HGNC key table.

components.name: Disease Type Free-Text Field
components.description: Free-text input for Art der Erkrankung (FK 5079). Used when structured justification options don't adequately describe the clinical indication. Available on all GNRs as a fallback.

entries.phaseName: Phase 2B.3 User Stories — Genetic Testing Documentation

surfaces.name: Schein/Billing Record View (from Phase 1.5)
surfaces.description: No new surface. Genetic testing GOPs trigger conditional fields on GNR entry rows. Different GOP groups require different field combinations (disease type only, gene symbol + disease type, or gene symbol + disease type + ICD code).

states.name: Disease Type Only Fields
states.trigger: GOP 11233 entered
states.changes: GNR row expands to show: disease type free-text field (FK 5079).

states.name: Gene Symbol + Disease Type Fields
states.trigger: GOPs 11511-11521 entered
states.changes: GNR row expands to show: HGNC gene symbol input (FK 5077) + disease type field (FK 5079). Both required.

states.name: Gene Symbol or Disease Type Fields
states.trigger: GOPs 11513/11522 entered
states.changes: GNR row expands to show: HGNC gene symbol input + disease type field. At least one required (flexible).

states.name: Full Genetic Documentation Fields
states.changes: GNR row expands to show: HGNC gene symbol input + disease type field + ICD-10-GM code input. All three required.

states.name: Disease Type per ICD Fields
states.changes: GNR row expands to show: disease type per ICD-10-GM classification.

components.surface: Expandable section on genetic testing GNR rows
components.name: Genetic Testing Field Set
components.description: A conditional field group that appears based on GOP type. Contains up to three fields: HGNC gene symbol (with autocomplete from Phase 2B.2), disease type free-text, and ICD-10-GM code input. Which fields appear and which are mandatory depends on the specific GOP.

components.name: GOP-Specific Field Indicator
components.description: A visual indicator showing which additional fields are required for this GOP. Helps the physician understand what documentation is needed before expanding.

entries.phaseName: Phase 2B.4 User Stories — OPS Procedure Codes

surfaces.name: Schein/Billing Record View (from Phase 1.5)
surfaces.description: Extended with OPS procedure code entry alongside GNR service codes. OPS codes serve as both billing justification and Paragraph 295 documentation. Laterality input is mandatory for applicable codes.

states.name: OPS Code Rejected
states.trigger: Physician enters an OPS code not in SDOPS
states.changes: Inline error: "OPS code does not exist in current master data." Entry blocked.

states.name: Laterality Required
states.trigger: OPS code requires side designation
states.changes: A laterality selector (R/L/B) appears as a mandatory field on the OPS entry row. Cannot be saved without selection.

states.name: Simultaneous Operations Panel
states.trigger: Physician documents multiple procedures in same session (optional)
states.changes: A grouping mechanism allows linking OPS codes as simultaneous operations with special billing rules from EBM chapters 31.2/36.2.

components.surface: Service section, alongside or below GNR input
components.name: OPS Code Input
components.description: A textbox for entering OPS procedure codes. Validates against SDOPS master data. Supports code search by number or keyword.

components.surface: Within Treatment Day Group, alongside GNR rows
components.name: OPS Entry Row
components.description: One row per OPS code. Shows: OPS code, description, laterality badge (if applicable), dual-function indicator (billing + §295).

components.name: Laterality Selector
components.description: A three-option selector: R (rechts/right), L (links/left), B (beidseitig/bilateral). Appears only for OPS codes that require laterality. Mandatory before save.

components.name: Dual-Function Indicator
components.description: A small label or icon indicating the OPS code serves both as billing justification and Paragraph 295 documentation. Informational only.

surfaces.name: Schein/Billing Record View (from Phase 1.5)
surfaces.description: Extended with psychotherapy-specific service documentation: BSNR/LANR assignment per GOP, combination treatment attribution, group therapy participant tracking, and Tagesprofil display.

surfaces.name: Termination Notice Manager
surfaces.description: A new view for creating, tracking, and sending psychotherapy termination notices (Beendigungsmitteilungen). Lists all pending/sent notices per quarter. Supports KIM transmission.

surfaces.name: PTV Form Print Preview
surfaces.description: A print preview surface for PTV 3 (application) and PTV 10 (assessor report) forms. Pre-populated from patient and treatment data.

states.name: Combination Treatment Mode
states.trigger: Two therapists documented for a patient's treatment
states.changes: Service rows show therapist attribution (LANR per therapist). A split indicator shows which services belong to which therapist. Billing rules enforce correct attribution.

states.name: Group Therapy Entry
states.trigger: Group therapy GOP entered
states.changes: Additional fields appear: number of participants, session duration. Billing is calculated per participant.

states.name: Tagesprofil Warning
states.trigger: Daily therapy time exceeds limit
states.changes: A warning appears in the Tagesprofil display: "Daily treatment limit exceeded ([X] minutes of [Y] maximum)." Non-blocking but prominent.

states.name: Termination Notice Draft
states.trigger: Physician creates a new termination notice
states.changes: Form appears with required fields: patient ID, treatment period, treatment type, reason for termination. Pseudo-GOP 88130/88131 reminder displayed.

states.name: Termination Notice Sent
states.trigger: Notice transmitted via KIM
states.changes: The notice status changes to "Sent" with timestamp. The quarterly tracker updates.

states.name: Notice Overdue
states.trigger: Quarter end approaching with unsent notices
states.changes: Overdue notices are flagged in the tracker with a warning indicator.

components.name: BSNR/LANR Assignment Fields
components.description: Fields for assigning practice site (BSNR, FK 5098) and physician (LANR, FK 5099) per service. For combination treatment, shows the second therapist's LANR.

components.surface: On GNR rows in combination treatment mode
components.name: Therapist Attribution Indicator
components.description: Visual indicator showing which therapist a service belongs to (e.g., colored badge per therapist or a therapist name label).

components.surface: Expandable on group therapy GNR rows
components.name: Group Therapy Fields
components.description: Number of participants input, session duration, per-participant billing calculation display.

components.surface: Schein/Billing Record View, sidebar or summary area
components.name: Tagesprofil Display
components.description: Shows total therapy minutes for the current day across all sessions. Color-coded: green (within limits), amber (approaching limit), red (exceeded).

components.name: Termination Notice Form
components.description: A form with fields: patient identification, treatment period (start/end dates), treatment type, reason for termination. Pre-populated where possible from treatment data.

components.name: Pseudo-GOP Reminder
components.description: An info banner: "Remember to document pseudo-GOP 88130 or 88131 for this termination." With a link or action to add the pseudo-GOP to the billing record.

components.name: KIM Send Action
components.description: A "Send via KIM" button on each completed notice. Shows status after sending (sent/failed).

components.name: Quarterly Notice Tracker
components.description: A list of all termination notices for the current quarter. Columns: patient, treatment type, status (draft/sent/overdue), date sent. Filterable.

components.name: PTV Form Preview
components.description: Pre-populated print view of PTV 3 or PTV 10 forms. Editable fields before printing. Print action.

entries.phaseName: Phase 2B.6 User Stories — EBM Master Data Functions

surfaces.name: Schein/Billing Record View (from Phase 1.5)
surfaces.description: No new surface. EBM master data functions operate within the existing service documentation: patient receipt text sourcing, automatic age-based GOP conversion, and optional real-time GNR adjustments.

states.name: Age-Based GOP Converted
states.trigger: Physician enters an age-unspecific Versichertenpauschale
states.changes: The system automatically converts to the correct age-specific supplementary code. An inline note shows: "Converted to [age-specific code] based on patient age [X]."

states.name: Real-Time GNR Adjustment (optional)
states.trigger: EBM check condition triggers a code modification at entry time
states.changes: The GNR is automatically adjusted based on EBM rules. An inline note explains the adjustment.

components.name: Patient Receipt Text
components.description: EBM-sourced Patiententext/Kurztext for each GOP. Displayed on the patient receipt. Not visible in the service entry UI itself, but sourced from EBM master data during receipt generation.

components.name: Age Conversion Indicator
components.description: A subtle note showing the original code was converted to an age-specific variant. Shows the conversion logic (patient age -> age class -> specific code).

entries.phaseName: Phase 2B.7 User Stories — HZV/FAV Service Documentation

surfaces.name: Schein/Billing Record View (from Phase 1.5)
surfaces.description: Extended with HZV/FAV-specific service documentation: contract-specific billing codes, BSNR/LANR/VP-ID assignment, service restrictions, substitute doctor marking, additional info fields, material cost capture, billing justification, and preventive case marking.

surfaces.name: Nursing Home Flat-Rate Documentation Panel
surfaces.description: An inline panel or dialog for documenting care facility data when billing the Pflegeheimpauschale (0008). Captures facility name and location with quarterly historization.

states.name: EBM-on-HZV Warning
states.trigger: Physician enters an EBM/KV service code in HZV/FAV context
states.changes: Prominent warning: "This is a KV billing code. You are in the HZV/FAV billing context. Verify the correct billing pathway."

states.name: Participation Required Block
states.trigger: No active contract participation for the patient
states.changes: Service entry is blocked: "Patient has no active HZV/FAV participation. Service documentation not permitted."

states.name: FAV Online Check
states.trigger: Physician attempts to document a FAV service
states.changes: Real-time online check of FAV participation status. Brief processing indicator. If active: proceed. If inactive: block.

states.name: Service Restriction Violation
states.trigger: Single/combination service rule violated
states.changes: Inline error on the GNR row: "This service cannot be combined with [other service]" or "This service can only be billed alone."

states.name: Contact Warning
states.trigger: No code 0000 documented in the billing case
states.changes: Warning banner on the billing record: "No doctor-patient contact (code 0000) documented for this case."

states.name: Deletion Blocked
states.trigger: Physician attempts to delete a submitted service
states.changes: Error: "This service has been submitted for billing and cannot be deleted." Delete action disabled.

states.name: Substitute Doctor Mode
states.trigger: Services documented by a substitute physician
states.changes: Services are marked as substitute (Vertreter). The substitute's identity is captured.

states.name: Preventive Case Marked
states.trigger: Treatment case marked as preventive (Vorsorge)
states.changes: A badge or indicator on the billing case header: "Vorsorge." Service catalog may change to show preventive-specific codes.

states.name: Nursing Home Hint
states.trigger: Pflegeheimpauschale (0008) entered
states.changes: Mandatory hint text displayed about documenting the facility address if it differs from the insured card address. Facility name/location input fields appear.

components.name: VP-ID / BSNR / LANR Fields
components.description: Contract participant ID, practice site number, and physician ID per service. Pre-filled from physician profile. Editable. LANR/BSNR support 9-digit entry.

components.name: Referring Doctor Fields
components.description: Mandatory LANR and BSNR of the referring physician for FAV services. Autocomplete from physician directory.

components.name: Service Filter
components.description: Filters available service codes by: KV region (from BSNR) and patient's insurance IK. Only shows codes valid for the current context.

components.name: Substitute Doctor Indicator
components.description: Badge showing the service was documented by a substitute. Substitute identity captured once per session, applied to all services.

components.name: Additional Info Fields
components.description: Per-service additional information fields as defined by the selective contract. Appear conditionally based on the service code.

components.name: Material Cost Panel
components.description: Captures material costs: manufacturer/supplier name, article/model number, cost amount. For services involving materials.

components.name: Billing Justification Field
components.description: Free-text billing justification for HZV/FAV services requiring medical necessity explanation. Transmitted with billing data.

components.name: Preventive Case Toggle
components.description: Toggle or selector to mark a treatment case as preventive (Vorsorge). Affects available service catalog and billing rules.

components.name: Blank Code Status Indicator
components.description: Shows whether a blank billing code is active or inactive. Inactive codes cannot be used for documentation.

components.name: Nursing Home Facility Fields
components.description: Input fields for: care facility name, care facility location (Ort). Stored with quarterly historization. Optional but prompted. Macro support for repeated facilities.

components.name: Contact Warning Banner
components.description: Amber warning: "No Arzt-Patienten-Kontakt (0000) documented." Appears when the billing case has services but no 0000 code.

entries.phaseName: Phase 2B.8 User Stories — HZV/FAV Referral & OPS Rules

surfaces.name: Schein/Billing Record View (from Phase 1.5)
surfaces.description: Extended with HZV/FAV referral form generation (auto-text injection) and FAV-specific OPS code documentation with validation against contract-specific master data.

surfaces.name: Referral Form Print Preview (from Phase 1.5 / Muster 6)
surfaces.description: Extended with auto-generated contract-specific text for HZV and FAV patients. FAV referrals additionally include a cover letter (Begleitschreiben).

states.name: HZV Referral Auto-Text
states.trigger: Referral form generated for an HZV patient (not FAV)
states.changes: The referral form includes automatically injected text indicating the patient's HZV enrollment status.

states.name: FAV Referral Auto-Text
states.trigger: Referral form generated for a FAV patient
states.changes: The referral form includes auto-generated FAV-specific text and additional contract-specific fields.

states.name: FAV Cover Letter
states.trigger: FAV referral being prepared
states.changes: A cover letter (Begleitschreiben) is generated alongside the referral form. Additional clinical and contract context for the receiving specialist.

states.name: FAV OPS Mandatory
states.trigger: FAV service requires OPS documentation
states.changes: An OPS code input field appears as mandatory on the GNR row. Validated against contract-specific OPS master data (Appendix 2).

states.name: FAV OPS Rejected
states.trigger: Invalid OPS code entered for FAV
states.changes: Inline error: "OPS code not valid for this FAV contract." Only codes from the contract-specific Appendix 2 are accepted.

components.name: HZV Auto-Text Block
components.description: Automatically inserted text block on the referral form indicating HZV enrollment. Not editable by the physician. Generated from patient contract data.

components.name: FAV Auto-Text Block
components.description: Automatically inserted text block with FAV participation details and contract-specific referral instructions. Includes additional fields per FAV specifications.

components.surface: Separate page/section in Referral Form Print Preview
components.name: FAV Cover Letter
components.description: A printable cover letter accompanying the Muster 6 referral form. Contains clinical context and contract-specific information for the receiving specialist.

components.name: FAV OPS Input
components.description: An OPS code input field validated against contract-specific OPS master data (Appendix 2). Mandatory for services requiring OPS documentation.

entries.phaseName: User Stories — KV Billing File Generation & Transmission

surfaces.name: Billing Dashboard (KV Mode)
surfaces.description: The unified billing surface in KV mode. Shows billing statistics, submission actions, transmission history, and file management. This is the primary workspace for quarterly KV billing. HZV/FAV billing appears as a separate tab/mode on this same surface.

states.name: Pre-Submission Review
states.trigger: User opens billing dashboard for the current quarter
states.changes: Statistics panel shows case counts, service totals, revenue estimates. Submission button is available.

states.name: Submitting (KV-Connect)
states.trigger: User clicks 1-Click-Abrechnung via KV-Connect
states.changes: Progress indicator replaces submission button. Channel indicator shows "KV-Connect".

states.name: Submitting (KIM)
states.trigger: User clicks 1-Click-Abrechnung via KIM
states.changes: Progress indicator replaces submission button. Channel indicator shows "KIM V2.1".

states.name: Success + Confirmation
states.trigger: Transmission completes successfully
states.changes: Success banner with timestamp, reference number, and confirmation details. Submission button disabled (prevents re-submission).

states.name: Error + Recovery
states.trigger: Transmission fails
states.changes: Error banner with actionable message explaining what failed and how to fix it. Retry button available.

states.name: File Location Display
states.trigger: User requests billing file location
states.changes: Panel or dialog showing the file system path to the encrypted KVDT billing file.

components.name: Billing Statistics Panel
components.description: Displays case counts, service totals, and revenue estimates for the current billing quarter. Allows pre-submission review.

components.name: Transmission Channel Selector
components.description: Toggle or dropdown to select between KV-Connect and KIM transmission channels.

components.name: File Path Indicator
components.description: Shows the storage path of the encrypted billing file. Includes a copy-to-clipboard action.

components.name: Transmission History List
components.description: Chronological list of past transmissions with timestamps, confirmation numbers, and status indicators.

surfaces.name: Patient Receipt Preview
surfaces.description: A printable receipt view accessible from the patient record. Shows services rendered with orientation values per Tabelle 11 layout. Supports optional extensions (diagnosis texts, Euro amounts).

states.name: Default (Orientation Values)
states.trigger: User generates receipt for a patient
states.changes: Receipt shows patient identification, treatment dates, service descriptions, and orientation values from SDEBM. Tabelle 11 layout.
