states.name: Extended: With Diagnosis Texts
states.trigger: User enables "Show Diagnoses" option
states.changes: Receipt additionally includes diagnosis texts alongside each service listing.

states.name: Extended: With Euro Amounts
states.trigger: User enables "Show Euro Amounts" option
states.changes: Receipt additionally shows Euro amounts for individual services.

states.name: Empty
states.trigger: Patient has no documented services for the quarter
states.changes: Receipt shell with patient identification but no services. Message indicating no billable services.

components.name: Service Line Item
components.description: One row per documented service: service code, description, date, orientation value. Optionally includes diagnosis text and/or Euro amount.

components.name: Receipt Options Toggle
components.description: Checkboxes or toggles for optional extensions: "Include Diagnosis Texts" and "Include Euro Amounts".

components.name: Print Action
components.description: Button to print or export the receipt as PDF.

surfaces.name: Lab Proficiency Gate (within Billing Dashboard)
surfaces.description: A validation panel shown during billing preparation for practices that bill laboratory services. Displays a color-coded certificate status matrix. Acts as a gate: if certificates are missing, lab services cannot be billed.

surfaces.name: pnSD Configuration Dialog
surfaces.description: A configuration dialog for practices using patient-near diagnostics (point-of-care testing). Captures device types and manufacturers for unit-use reagents. Only shown for applicable specialty groups.

states.name: All Valid (Green)
states.trigger: All required certificates are present for billed analytes
states.changes: Green status indicator. All material-analyte-GOP rows show "present." RVSA dataset ready for transmission. Billing can proceed.

states.name: Missing Certificates (Red/Yellow)
states.trigger: One or more required certificates are missing
states.changes: Affected rows highlighted in red (blocking) or yellow (warning). Statistics show counts with/without certificates. Billing blocked until resolved.

states.name: Participation Obligation Detected
states.trigger: System finds lab services that require proficiency testing
states.changes: Alert indicating new RV participation obligations based on documented lab services. Prompts user to configure analytes and upload certificates.

states.name: pnSD Configuration Needed
states.trigger: Practice specialty supports pnSD/uu but no devices configured
states.changes: Warning prompting user to configure at least one device type and manufacturer before pnSD services can be billed.

components.name: Certificate Status Matrix
components.description: Table of material-analyte-GOP combinations with color-coded certificate status: present (green), not present (red), pnSD/uu (blue/special).

components.name: Analyte Selector
components.description: Interface for selecting practice-site-specific RV analytes based on materials used. Selections are stored permanently.

components.name: Certificate Statistics Summary
components.description: Aggregate counts: total analyte combinations, certificates present, certificates missing. Quarterly validation status.

components.name: pnSD Device Entry
components.description: Form fields for device type and manufacturer. At least one required when pnSD/uu is confirmed.

entries.phaseName: User Stories — ASV Billing (§116b SGB V)

surfaces.name: ASV Team Configuration (within Practice Settings)
surfaces.description: A settings panel where the practice manages its ASV team number(s). Each team number is associated with the practice's BSNR.

surfaces.name: Billing Dashboard (ASV Mode)
surfaces.description: An ASV-specific mode/tab within the unified Billing Dashboard. Shows ASV-billed services with team number assignments, material cost documentation, and ASV-specific submission actions.

states.name: No ASV Teams Configured
states.trigger: Practice has not set up any ASV team numbers
states.changes: ASV mode shows an empty state prompting the user to configure at least one ASV team number in Practice Settings.

states.name: ASV Services Listed
states.trigger: Practice has documented ASV services for the quarter
states.changes: ASV mode shows a list of services marked with team numbers, including material cost entries where applicable.

states.name: Team Number Missing
states.trigger: A GOP was documented under ASV but no team number assigned
states.changes: Warning indicator on the affected service row. Billing blocked until team number is assigned.

components.surface: ASV Mode, per service row or batch assignment
components.name: Team Number Selector
components.description: Dropdown or assignment control for linking a GOP to a specific ASV team number (FK 5100).

components.surface: ASV Mode, expandable per service row
components.name: Material Cost Entry
components.description: Fields for manufacturer/supplier name (FK 5074) and article/model number (FK 5075) when material costs (FK 5012) apply to a service.

components.name: ASV Team List
components.description: Editable list of ASV team numbers with their associated BSNR. Add/edit/delete actions.

surfaces.name: Billing Dashboard (HZV/FAV Mode)
surfaces.description: The HZV/FAV tab/mode within the unified Billing Dashboard. Shows billing preparation tools: control list, summary statistics, case selection, fee schedule indicator, and substitute doctor attribution.

states.name: Preparation Overview
states.trigger: User opens HZV/FAV mode for billing preparation
states.changes: Control list and summary panel load with all billable HZV/FAV cases. Fee schedule indicator shows which Honorarverzeichnis is active.

states.name: Case Selection / Filtering
states.trigger: User selects/deselects cases, contracts, or time periods
states.changes: Case list updates to reflect inclusion/exclusion. Summary recalculates totals.

states.name: Preventive Case Auto-Add
states.trigger: Billing preparation run detects a preventive treatment case
states.changes: Notification that code 80092.2 was automatically added to the preventive case. Added item highlighted in the control list.

states.name: Substitute Doctor Review
states.trigger: Cases exist where a substitute doctor provided services
states.changes: Substitute doctor attribution panel shows which services were documented by a substitute, with their LANR. Allows review before submission.

components.name: Control List
components.description: Detailed list of all billable cases with services and amounts. Scrollable, filterable. Each row shows patient, services, and billing amounts.

components.name: Billing Summary Panel
components.description: Aggregated statistics: total cases, service counts, financial totals. Updates as cases are selected/deselected.

components.surface: HZV/FAV Mode, toolbar or filter area
components.name: Case Selector
components.description: Controls for selecting/deselecting cases by contract, time period, or individual case. Includes "select all" and "deselect all" actions.

components.name: Fee Schedule Indicator
components.description: Shows which Honorarverzeichnis is active for the current contract and billing period. Read-only display.

components.name: Substitute Doctor Badge
components.description: Indicator showing that services in this case were attributed to a substitute doctor, with the substitute's LANR.

surfaces.name: Billing Validation Results Panel (within Billing Dashboard, HZV/FAV mode)
surfaces.description: Displays the results of the billing validation run (Abrechnungspruflauf). Shows errors and warnings organized by category, with drill-down to individual cases. Acts as a gate: errors must be resolved before submission.

states.name: Validation Running
states.trigger: User initiates billing validation or it starts automatically during billing preparation
states.changes: Progress indicator showing validation in progress. Category-by-category progress if possible.

states.name: All Passed (Green)
states.trigger: Validation completes with no errors and no warnings
states.changes: Green status banner. Submission button enabled. Optional link to view validation details.

states.name: Errors Found (Red)
states.trigger: Validation finds blocking errors
states.changes: Red status banner with error count. Error list displayed grouped by category. Submission button disabled. "Fix and Re-validate" action available.

states.name: Warnings Only (Yellow)
states.trigger: Validation completes with warnings but no blocking errors
states.changes: Yellow status banner with warning count. Warning list displayed. Submission button enabled (warnings are non-blocking).

components.name: Error List
components.description: Filterable list of validation errors grouped by type: diagnosis, OPS, referral, material cost, justification. Each error shows affected case, service, and rule reference.

components.surface: Validation Results, below error list or separate tab
components.name: Warning List
components.description: List of non-blocking warnings for QA and audit. Similar structure to error list but with yellow indicators.

components.name: Category Filter
components.description: Filter controls to view errors by category: Diagnoses, OPS, Referrals, Material Costs, Justifications, Additional Info, Birth Date.

components.name: Case Drill-Down
components.description: Clicking an error expands to show the full billing case context: patient, all services, all diagnoses, and which specific item triggered the error.

components.name: Validation Summary Badge
components.description: Compact status indicator showing validation state: not run, passed, errors, warnings. Always visible in the billing dashboard header.

surfaces.name: HZV/FAV Submission Panel (within Billing Dashboard, HZV/FAV mode)
surfaces.description: The submission interface for HZV/FAV billing. Contains channel selection, connectivity test, submit action, and confirmation display. Handles both billing and prescription data transmission.

surfaces.name: Transmission Protocol View
surfaces.description: A PDF viewer or detail panel showing the HAEVG transmission protocol after successful submission. Accessible from the submission panel and from the transmission history.

states.name: Channel Selection
states.trigger: User opens submission panel
states.changes: Channel selector visible (online/offline). Current default highlighted. Connectivity test button available.

states.name: Connectivity Test: Testing
states.trigger: User clicks connectivity test
states.changes: Test indicator animating. Channel selector locked during test.

states.name: Connectivity Test: Pass
states.trigger: Test returns positive
states.changes: Green checkmark next to selected channel. Submit button enabled.

states.name: Connectivity Test: Fail
states.trigger: Online test fails (no certificate or connection)
states.changes: Error message with specific German text about HAEVG certificate requirement. Channel reverts to previous selection.

states.name: Submitting
states.trigger: User clicks submit
states.changes: Progress indicator. Both billing and prescription data transmission in progress. Status shown separately for each.

states.name: Success + Confirmation
states.trigger: Billing transmission succeeds (UebermittlungsStatus = 'OK')
states.changes: Success banner with timestamp and reference. Transmission protocol link. Prescription count shown (if real data, not test). Re-submission blocked.

states.name: Success + Protocol PDF
states.trigger: User opens transmission protocol
states.changes: PDF viewer displays the HAEVG Pruefmodul transmission protocol. Saved and accessible anytime.

states.name: Error + Recovery
states.trigger: Transmission fails
states.changes: Error message with specific failure reason. Retry available. If only prescription data failed, billing success is preserved and prescription retry is available separately.

states.name: Late Submission Warning
states.trigger: Submission date is near or past the Nachreichfrist
states.changes: Warning banner at top of submission panel showing the deadline and how many days remain or how many days overdue.

states.name: Offline Mode
states.trigger: User selects offline billing
states.changes: CD/data carrier save option replaces online submit button.

components.name: Channel Selector
components.description: Toggle between Online-Abrechnung and Offline-Abrechnung. Selection persists across updates.

components.surface: Submission Panel, next to channel selector
components.name: Connectivity Test Button
components.description: Tests connection to HAEVG Rechenzentrum. Available anytime.

components.name: Dual Status Indicator
components.description: Two separate status lines: billing data transmission status and prescription data transmission status. Each shows independently.

components.name: Prescription Count Badge
components.description: Shows count of successfully transmitted prescriptions. Only displayed for real submissions, not test submissions. Excludes deleted prescriptions.

components.name: Late Submission Banner
components.description: Warning with deadline date, days remaining/overdue. Color-coded: yellow (approaching), red (past).

components.name: Protocol Link
components.description: Link to open the transmission protocol PDF. If user already clicked this, auto-display of protocol is suppressed.

entries.phaseName: User Stories — HZV/FAV Special Cases & Corrections

surfaces.name: KV/HZV Conflict Review Panel
surfaces.description: Shown during KV billing preparation. Lists HZV-enrolled patients found in KV billing data and misdocumented EBM services. Acts as a pre-KV-submission review to prevent cross-billing errors.

surfaces.name: Post-Submission Editor (Medi contracts only)
surfaces.description: An editing interface available after billing submission for Medi-type contracts. Allows modifying, adding, and deleting services and diagnoses retroactively.

surfaces.name: AOK Check 18+ Panel (within Patient Record)
surfaces.description: A dedicated action panel for documenting and transmitting the pre-enrollment service UHU35. Appears in the patient record for eligible non-enrolled patients.

states.name: Conflicts Detected
states.trigger: KV billing prep finds HZV patients in KV billing
states.changes: Conflict Review Panel shows list of affected patients. Staff must review before KV submission can proceed.

states.name: Misdocumented Services Found
states.trigger: KV billing validation detects EBM services from HZV Ziffernkranz on KV-Schein
states.changes: Error list auto-displayed with patient details, service quarter, and misdocumented EBM codes.

states.name: No Conflicts
states.trigger: KV billing prep finds no HZV patients in KV billing
states.changes: Conflict Review Panel either hidden or shows green "No conflicts" status.

states.name: Post-Submission Edit Mode
states.trigger: Staff opens Post-Submission Editor for a Medi contract billing
states.changes: Editable view of previously submitted services and diagnoses. Add/modify/delete actions available.

states.name: AOK Check 18+ Available
states.trigger: Patient meets UHU35 eligibility criteria
states.changes: "AOK Check 18+" button visible in patient record. Confirmation dialog before transmission.

states.name: AOK Check 18+ Transmitted
states.trigger: UHU35 successfully transmitted
states.changes: Button disabled or replaced with "Transmitted" indicator. Entry recorded in patient Karteikarte.

components.name: HZV Patient Conflict List
components.description: Table of HZV-enrolled patients appearing in KV billing. Columns: patient name, case details, enrollment status. Allows staff to review and correct routing.

components.surface: Conflict Review Panel, below or tab
components.name: Misdocumented EBM List
components.description: Auto-generated error list showing: patient name, first name, DOB, eGK number, service quarter, misdocumented EBM service code. Excludes emergency service (Notfalldienst) cases.

components.name: Diagnosis Correction Placeholder (999999)
components.description: Special service code 999999 available when a billing case needs to be submitted but lacks a proper diagnosis. Flagged visually as "pending correction."

components.name: AOK Check 18+ Button
components.description: Button labeled "AOK Check 18+" (NOT "UHU35" or "Vor-Einschreibe-Leistung"). Only visible for eligible patients.

components.name: Confirmation Dialog
components.description: Specific German-language confirmation prompt before UHU35 transmission. Shows JA/NEIN options.

surfaces.name: Prescription Builder
surfaces.description: The primary workspace for creating an electronic prescription. Supports four medication types (PZN, Ingredient, Compounding, FreeText). Contains medication search, dosage entry, patient/insurance context, and aut-idem toggle.
surfaces.capabilities: Prescription creation, medication type selection, dosage entry, aut-idem

surfaces.name: Prescription Queue
surfaces.description: A queue/list of unsigned prescriptions awaiting batch signing. Shows prescription details, patient name, medication, and signing status. Supports select-all and batch operations.
surfaces.capabilities: Batch signing, queue management, comfort signature

surfaces.name: Patient Copy Preview
surfaces.description: Print preview of the patient-readable prescription copy. Shows DataMatrix barcode encoding the E-Rezept token, medication details, dosage instructions, and patient information.

surfaces.name: Prescription Status View
surfaces.description: Shows the lifecycle status of submitted prescriptions. Tracks E-Rezept Fachdienst status (created, in progress, dispensed, cancelled). Accessible from patient context.

states.name: PZN Mode
states.trigger: User selects "PZN-based" medication type
states.changes: Drug search field appears. Selecting a PZN auto-populates drug name, form, pack size, Normgröße. Aut-idem checkbox visible.

states.name: Ingredient Mode
states.trigger: User selects "Ingredient-based" medication type
states.changes: Active ingredient field, strength, dosage form, and quantity fields appear. No PZN auto-populate.

states.name: Compounding Mode
states.trigger: User selects "Compounding" medication type
states.changes: Free-form recipe editor appears with ingredient list, quantities, and preparation instructions.

states.name: FreeText Mode
states.trigger: User selects "Free-text" medication type
states.changes: Single large text field for unstructured prescription text. Minimal validation.

states.name: MVO Configuration
states.trigger: User enables "Mehrfachverordnung" toggle
states.changes: Repeat prescription fields appear: number of repeats, validity period, dispensing interval.

states.name: Pseudo-IK Active
states.trigger: Patient is enrolled in AOK BW HzV/FaV
states.changes: Insurance field shows Pseudo-IK 108095250 instead of real Kassen-IK. Visual indicator explains the substitution. BG cases excluded.

states.name: Comfort Signature Active
states.trigger: Physician activates comfort signature session
states.changes: Session counter shows "X/250 signatures used today." Single-sign indicator in header. All queue items signable without re-entering PIN.

states.name: Comfort Signature Exhausted
states.trigger: 250 signatures reached in current session
states.changes: Warning: "250 signature limit reached. Re-authenticate to continue." PIN entry required.

states.name: Signing in Progress
states.trigger: User initiates batch signing
states.changes: Progress indicator shows signing status per prescription. Completed items move to "signed" state. Errors highlighted.

states.name: Submission Success
states.trigger: E-Rezept successfully submitted to Fachdienst
states.changes: Status shows "Created" with Task ID. Patient copy available for print.

states.name: Submission Error
states.trigger: E-Rezept submission fails
states.changes: Error details displayed with retry option. FHIR validation errors shown if applicable.

states.name: Dispensed
states.trigger: Pharmacy has dispensed the medication
states.changes: Status shows "Dispensed" with pharmacy info and dispense date. Read-only.

states.name: Cancelled
states.trigger: Prescription cancelled before dispensing
states.changes: Status shows "Cancelled" with reason and timestamp.

components.name: Medication Search
components.description: Type-ahead search field querying the drug database by PZN, drug name, or ingredient. Results show trade name, manufacturer, pack size, PZN, availability.

components.name: Dosage Entry
components.description: Structured dosage input: morning/noon/evening/night fields, unit selector, free-text dosage instructions.

components.name: Aut-Idem Toggle
components.description: Checkbox to exclude aut-idem substitution. When checked, "no substitution" is flagged on the prescription.

components.name: MVO Fields
components.description: Repeat count, validity start/end, dispensing interval fields. Validates against gematik MVO rules.

components.name: Insurance Context Bar
components.description: Shows patient name, insurance, Kassen-IK (or Pseudo-IK if applicable), and enrollment status. Read-only context from patient master data.

components.name: Prescription Card
components.description: A compact card per prescription showing: patient name, medication, type, creation date, signing status. Selectable for batch operations.

components.name: Comfort Signature Counter
components.description: Shows current session signature count (e.g., "47/250"). Updates in real-time as prescriptions are signed.

components.name: DataMatrix Barcode
components.description: Encoded barcode containing E-Rezept token (Task ID + AccessCode). Scannable by pharmacies.

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Color-coded badge showing current lifecycle state: Created (blue), In Progress (yellow), Dispensed (green), Cancelled (red).

surfaces.name: Drug Search Panel
surfaces.description: Embedded within the Prescription Builder (Phase 4.1). Provides multi-entry-point drug search (PZN, ingredient, indication) with rich result cards showing pricing, availability, alternatives, and rebate contract status.

surfaces.name: Interaction Alert Dialog
surfaces.description: Modal or inline alert shown during prescription creation when drug-drug interactions are detected. Displays severity, clinical guidance, and the conflicting medications.

surfaces.name: Dosage Calculator Panel
surfaces.description: Embedded panel within the Prescription Builder that calculates weight-based or age-based dosage recommendations for the selected medication.

surfaces.name: Red Hand Letter Alert
surfaces.description: Modal alert shown when prescribing a medication that has an active Rote-Hand-Brief (urgent safety notification). Shows the alert text and requires acknowledgment.

states.name: Search Results
states.trigger: User enters search query
states.changes: Results list appears with drug cards showing trade name, PZN, manufacturer, pack size, Normgröße, price, availability, and Rx/OTC status.

states.name: Economic Comparison
states.trigger: Results displayed for a medication with alternatives
states.changes: Generic alternatives, biosimilar options, and rebate contract indicators shown alongside or below the selected drug. Price comparison visible.

states.name: Aut-Idem Guidance
states.trigger: User selects a medication with substitution options
states.changes: Aut-idem status displayed. If exclusion is checked, a note explains the clinical justification requirement.

states.name: No Interactions
states.trigger: No interactions detected
states.changes: No dialog appears. Prescription proceeds normally.

states.name: Minor Interaction
states.trigger: Minor or moderate interaction detected
states.changes: Yellow warning with interaction details and clinical guidance. Doctor can acknowledge and proceed.

states.name: Severe Interaction
states.trigger: Severe or contraindicated interaction detected
states.changes: Red alert with strong warning text, clinical guidance, and conflicting medications. Doctor must explicitly acknowledge the risk to proceed.

states.name: Dosage Recommendation
states.trigger: Medication selected and patient weight/age available
states.changes: Calculated dosage shown based on patient data. Recommendation displayed as a suggestion, not auto-applied.

states.name: Active Red Hand Letter
states.trigger: Prescribing a drug with an active Rote-Hand-Brief
states.changes: Full alert text displayed in a prominent modal. Doctor must acknowledge before continuing.

components.name: Drug Result Card
components.description: A card per search result showing: trade name, manufacturer, PZN, pack size, Normgröße, dosage form, price, availability indicator, Rx/OTC badge, rebate contract badge.

components.name: Price Comparison Row
components.description: Shows selected drug price vs. cheapest generic and rebate contract option side-by-side.

components.name: Rebate Contract Badge
components.description: Visual indicator showing whether the drug is covered by a rebate contract with the patient's insurance fund. Green = covered, grey = not.

components.name: Interaction Severity Badge
components.description: Color-coded severity indicator: red (contraindicated), orange (severe), yellow (moderate), blue (minor).

components.name: Conflicting Medication List
components.description: Shows the interacting medications: the one being prescribed and the one(s) already on the patient's medication list or BMP.

components.name: Dosage Result Display
components.description: Shows calculated dose with formula breakdown (e.g., "0.5mg/kg x 70kg = 35mg"). Includes "Apply to prescription" action.

surfaces.name: Heilmittel Prescription Form
surfaces.description: A specialized prescription form for therapeutic remedies. Separate from the medication Prescription Builder (Phase 4.1) because Heilmittel have different data requirements: therapy type, diagnosis group, remedy selection from Heilmittelkatalog, quantity, frequency, and therapy goals.

surfaces.name: Quantity Tracking Panel
surfaces.description: A panel (embedded or sidebar) showing the patient's running totals of prescribed Heilmittel quantities against catalog limits. Displays remaining allowance per diagnosis group across quarters.

states.name: Therapy Type Selection
states.trigger: User opens the form
states.changes: Therapy type selector displayed: Physiotherapy, Speech Therapy, Occupational Therapy, Podology, Nutritional Therapy. Selection determines available remedy options.

states.name: Standard Prescription
states.trigger: User selects therapy type and enters diagnosis
states.changes: Form populated with valid remedy-diagnosis combinations from Heilmittelkatalog. Standard quantity limits shown.

states.name: LHM (Long-Term) Prescription
states.trigger: User enables "Langfristverordnung" toggle
states.changes: Extended quantity fields and approval tracking fields appear. Pre-approved chronic condition flag shown. Quantity limits expanded per LHM rules.

states.name: BVB (Special Need) Prescription
states.trigger: User enables "Besonderer Verordnungsbedarf" toggle
states.changes: Special justification field appears. Quantity limits adjusted per BVB rules. Indicator that this prescription falls outside standard limits.

states.name: Within Limits
states.trigger: Running total is within catalog limits
states.changes: Green indicator. Shows remaining quantity allowance.

states.name: Approaching Limit
states.trigger: Running total is near the catalog limit
states.changes: Yellow warning. Shows how many units remain before the limit is reached.

states.name: Limit Exceeded
states.trigger: Prescribed quantity would exceed catalog limit
states.changes: Red alert. Shows the overage amount. Doctor must provide justification or switch to LHM/BVB.

components.name: Therapy Type Selector
components.description: Radio buttons or segmented control for the five therapy types. Selecting a type filters the available remedies below.

components.name: Diagnosis-Remedy Picker
components.description: Linked selection: first enter the ICD-10 diagnosis, then the system shows valid remedies from the Heilmittelkatalog for that diagnosis group. Invalid combinations are not selectable.

components.name: Quantity & Frequency Fields
components.description: Number of sessions, frequency per week, and therapy duration. Validates against catalog limits for the selected diagnosis group.

components.name: Therapy Goal Field
components.description: Free-text field for specifying the therapeutic goal (e.g., "improve mobility," "restore speech fluency").

components.name: Running Total Indicator
components.description: Bar or counter showing: "X of Y units prescribed (Z remaining)" for the current diagnosis group. Spans across quarters.

components.name: LHM/BVB Toggle
components.description: Toggles for Langfristverordnung and Besonderer Verordnungsbedarf. Mutually exclusive with standard prescribing for the same diagnosis group.

surfaces.name: Hilfsmittel Prescription Form
surfaces.description: A specialized prescription form for medical aids. Uses statutory forms (Muster 8, 8A, 15, 16) depending on the aid type. Contains diagnosis, medical justification, aid selection from Hilfsmittelverzeichnis, and supplier selection.

surfaces.name: Hilfsmittelverzeichnis Search
surfaces.description: A searchable catalog browser for the GKV Hilfsmittelverzeichnis. Allows searching by product group, product type, or product name. Shows product details, position numbers, and insurance coverage status.

states.name: Muster 8 (Standard)
states.trigger: User selects standard medical aid
states.changes: Standard Muster 8 form fields: diagnosis, justification, aid description, quantity, duration of need.

states.name: Muster 8A (Specific Categories)
states.trigger: User selects aid in specific category requiring Muster 8A
states.changes: Muster 8A form fields, which include additional category-specific documentation requirements.

states.name: Muster 15 (Hearing Aid)
states.trigger: User prescribes a hearing aid
states.changes: Muster 15 form fields: audiometric findings, hearing loss details, previous hearing aid history.

states.name: Muster 16 (Special Approval)
states.trigger: User selects aid requiring special approval
states.changes: Muster 16 form fields: detailed medical justification, expected outcome, alternative treatments considered.

states.name: Search Results
states.trigger: User enters search query
states.changes: Results list showing product groups, position numbers, product names, manufacturers, and coverage indicators.

states.name: Supplier Selection
states.trigger: Aid selected, supplier needed
states.changes: List of contracted suppliers for the patient's insurance fund. Shows supplier name, contact info, and contract status.

components.name: Form Type Selector
components.description: Selector for the appropriate Muster form (8, 8A, 15, 16). May auto-select based on the chosen aid category.

components.name: Diagnosis & Justification
components.description: ICD-10 diagnosis field plus free-text medical justification explaining why the aid is needed.

components.name: Aid Selector
components.description: Field linked to Hilfsmittelverzeichnis search. Shows selected product group, position number, and product description.

components.name: Supplier Picker
components.description: Dropdown or list of contracted suppliers filtered by patient's insurance fund. Includes contact information.

components.name: Product Group Browser
components.description: Hierarchical browser for product groups (Produktgruppen). Navigate by group → subgroup → product type → specific product.

components.name: Coverage Indicator
components.description: Badge showing whether the product is covered by the patient's insurance fund. Green = covered, yellow = requires prior approval, red = not covered.

surfaces.name: DiGA Prescription Builder
surfaces.description: A specialized prescription surface for prescribing digital health applications (DiGA). Contains DiGA search from BfArM directory, indication validation against patient diagnoses, and eVDGA FHIR bundle generation. Separate from the medication Prescription Builder because DiGA have unique fields (DiGA-VE-ID, app name, indication alignment).

surfaces.name: DiGA Directory Browser
surfaces.description: A searchable catalog of approved digital health applications from the BfArM DiGA directory. Shows app details, approved indications, listing status, and PZN (if applicable).

states.name: DiGA Search
states.trigger: User opens the builder
states.changes: Search field for DiGA by name, indication, or DiGA-VE-ID. No DiGA selected yet.

states.name: DiGA Selected
states.trigger: User selects a DiGA from search results
states.changes: DiGA details displayed: app name, DiGA-VE-ID, PZN, approved indications, listing status. Indication validation runs against patient's documented diagnoses.

states.name: Indication Match
states.trigger: Selected DiGA's indication matches patient's diagnoses
states.changes: Green indicator: "Indication aligned with documented diagnosis [ICD code]." Prescription can proceed.

states.name: Indication Mismatch
states.trigger: No matching diagnosis found in patient record
states.changes: Yellow warning: "No documented diagnosis matching this DiGA's indication. Add diagnosis or document justification."

states.name: DiGA Not Currently Listed
states.trigger: Selected DiGA is delisted or pending re-evaluation
states.changes: Red warning: "This DiGA is not currently listed in the BfArM directory. Prescribing not possible." Prescription blocked.

states.name: eVDGA Signed & Submitted
states.trigger: Prescription signed and submitted to Fachdienst
states.changes: Confirmation with Task ID. Patient copy with redemption instructions available.

states.name: Directory Results
states.trigger: User enters search query
states.changes: Results show DiGA cards with app name, manufacturer, indications, listing status, and DiGA-VE-ID.

components.name: DiGA Search Field
components.description: Type-ahead search querying the BfArM DiGA directory by app name, indication, or DiGA-VE-ID.

components.name: DiGA Detail Card
components.description: Shows selected DiGA: app name, manufacturer, DiGA-VE-ID, PZN, approved indications, listing status (permanently listed / preliminary / delisted), and a brief description.

components.surface: DiGA Prescription Builder, below detail card
components.name: Indication Validator
components.description: Compares the DiGA's approved indications against the patient's documented ICD-10 diagnoses. Shows match status (green/yellow).

components.name: Patient Redemption Copy
components.description: Printable copy with instructions for the patient on how to redeem the DiGA prescription (e.g., via Gematik app or insurance website).

components.name: DiGA Directory Card
components.description: Card per search result showing: app icon/name, manufacturer, indication keywords, listing status badge, DiGA-VE-ID.

components.surface: DiGA Directory Card, DiGA Detail Card
components.name: Listing Status Badge
components.description: Color-coded badge: green (permanently listed), yellow (preliminary listing), red (delisted/not listed).

surfaces.name: Medication Plan Editor
surfaces.description: The primary workspace for viewing, creating, and editing the patient's Bundeseinheitlicher Medikationsplan (BMP). Shows all medications in a structured list with dosage schedules (morning/noon/evening/night), organized by sections. Supports drag-and-drop reordering and section management.

surfaces.name: BMP Print Preview
surfaces.description: Print preview of the BMP including the 2D DataMatrix barcode. The printed plan follows the standardized BMP layout that patients and pharmacies expect.

surfaces.name: BMP Import Dialog
surfaces.description: Dialog shown when importing a BMP from an external source (scanned barcode or electronic transfer). Shows the imported medications alongside existing records for reconciliation.

states.name: Empty Plan
states.trigger: Patient has no BMP yet
states.changes: Empty state with "Create Medication Plan" prompt. Option to import from scanned barcode or start fresh.

states.name: Active Plan
states.trigger: Patient has an existing BMP
states.changes: Full medication list with sections, dosage schedules, and action buttons (add, edit, remove, reorder).

states.name: Edit Mode
states.trigger: User clicks "Edit" on a medication entry
states.changes: Inline editing of medication details: dosage, schedule, notes. Drug search available to change the medication.

states.name: Reorder Mode
states.trigger: User activates reorder/drag-drop
states.changes: Medication rows become draggable. Section headers become draggable for group reordering. Visual handles indicate draggable items.

states.name: Section Management
states.trigger: User adds/edits section headers
states.changes: Section header editing: custom titles (e.g., "Cardiac," "Diabetes"), add new sections, move medications between sections.

states.name: Import Preview
states.trigger: Barcode scanned or electronic BMP received
states.changes: Side-by-side view: imported medications on the left, existing patient medications on the right. Conflicts highlighted. Merge/replace actions available.

states.name: Version Mismatch
states.trigger: Imported BMP uses a different specification version
states.changes: Warning showing the imported version and the current version. System handles conversion automatically but alerts the user.

states.name: Print Ready
states.trigger: User opens print preview
states.changes: Full BMP layout with DataMatrix barcode, medication list, dosage grid, patient info, and prescriber info. Print action available.

components.name: Medication Row
components.description: A row per medication showing: trade name (or ingredient), strength, dosage form, dosage schedule (M/N/E/Ni grid), unit, and notes. Editable inline.

components.name: Dosage Grid
components.description: Four-column grid for morning (M), noon (N), evening (E), night (Ni) dosages. Each cell shows the dose amount or "—" if not applicable.

components.name: Section Header
components.description: A grouping header (e.g., "Herz-Kreislauf," "Diabetes") that organizes medications by therapeutic category. Collapsible.

components.surface: Medication Plan Editor, toolbar or section footer
components.name: Add Medication Button
components.description: Opens a drug search to add a new medication to the plan. Supports adding prescription drugs, OTC, and supplements.

components.name: Allergy/Intolerance Note
components.description: Prominent display of patient's documented allergies and intolerances. Critical for medication safety context.

components.name: DataMatrix Barcode
components.description: 2D barcode encoding the full BMP data per BMP specification. Scannable by pharmacies and other PVS systems to import the plan.

components.name: Conflict Row
components.description: A row in the import preview highlighting a medication that conflicts with an existing entry (e.g., same drug with different dosage). Shows both versions side-by-side.

components.surface: Medication Plan Editor, header; BMP Print Preview
components.name: Prescriber Info
components.description: Shows the doctor's name, practice address, and phone number as the responsible prescriber for the plan.

surfaces.name: Form Print Preview
surfaces.description: Preview of a statutory form (Muster) before printing. Shows the form layout with all populated fields, barcodes, and patient data exactly as it will appear on paper. Used across all form types (Muster 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 16, 39, etc.).
surfaces.capabilities: Form rendering, field positioning, barcode display

surfaces.name: Form Printer Settings
surfaces.description: Configuration surface for form printing parameters: printer selection (laser/dot-matrix), paper tray, alignment offset calibration, and test print. Accessed from system settings or first-time form print.

states.name: Form Populated
states.trigger: User initiates form print from a clinical workflow (prescription, referral, sick leave, etc.)
states.changes: Form layout rendered with patient data, diagnosis, service details populated in the correct field positions. PDF417 barcode generated if required by the form type.

states.name: Barcode Present
states.trigger: Form type requires PDF417 barcode
states.changes: Barcode rendered in the designated area of the form. Barcode data fields encoded per KBV specification.

states.name: Field Overflow
states.trigger: A data field exceeds the allocated space on the form
states.changes: Truncated text with visual indicator. Tooltip or secondary view shows full text. Truncation follows KBV specification rules.

states.name: Laser Printer Mode
states.trigger: Laser printer selected
states.changes: Laser-optimized print settings shown. Resolution and positioning parameters for laser output.

states.name: Dot-Matrix Mode
states.trigger: Dot-matrix printer selected
states.changes: Dot-matrix settings shown. Character spacing and continuous form feed parameters.

states.name: Alignment Calibration
states.trigger: User runs alignment test
states.changes: Test print pattern generated. User adjusts X/Y offset to align fields with pre-printed form paper.

components.name: Form Canvas
components.description: The rendered form showing field positions, text content, checkboxes, and barcodes on the form grid. Displays at actual print scale.

components.name: PDF417 Barcode
components.description: Machine-readable barcode encoding the form's structured data per KBV specification. Positioned precisely within the barcode zone.

components.name: Field Grid Overlay
components.description: An optional overlay showing the KBV field grid boundaries. Useful during alignment calibration to verify field positioning.

components.name: Printer Selector
components.description: Dropdown listing available printers with type indicators (laser/dot-matrix).

components.name: Offset Controls
components.description: X/Y offset sliders or number fields for fine-tuning print alignment (in mm). Per-printer, per-form-type settings.

components.name: Test Print Button
components.description: Generates a test print with alignment markers for calibration verification.

surfaces.name: eAU Form
surfaces.description: The data entry form for creating an electronic sick leave certificate. Captures patient ID, diagnosis (ICD-10), incapacity period, certificate type (initial/follow-up/final), and accident indicators. Pre-populates from patient record.

surfaces.name: eAU Transmission Status
surfaces.description: A status view showing all sent eAUs with their delivery status (sent, delivered, failed, cancelled). Includes insurer feedback messages. Accessible from patient context or as a practice-wide list.

surfaces.name: eAU Print Preview (Patient/Employer Copies)
surfaces.description: Print preview for the patient copy (with diagnosis) and employer copy (without diagnosis). Includes barcode for verification.

states.name: Initial Certificate
states.trigger: User selects "Erstbescheinigung"
states.changes: Standard fields displayed. Start date defaults to today.

states.name: Follow-Up Certificate
states.trigger: User selects "Folgebescheinigung"
states.changes: Previous eAU reference shown. Start date continues from prior certificate. Original diagnosis carried forward (editable).

states.name: Final Certificate
states.trigger: User selects "Endbescheinigung"
states.changes: End date marked as definitive. Return-to-work date field appears.

states.name: Accident/Occupational
states.trigger: User checks accident or occupational disease indicator
states.changes: Additional fields: accident date, accident type, Berufsgenossenschaft reference.

states.name: Sent & Delivered
states.trigger: KIM DSN confirms delivery
states.changes: Green status badge. Delivery timestamp shown.

states.name: Sent & Failed
states.trigger: KIM DSN reports failure
states.changes: Red status badge. Error details shown. Retry button available.

states.name: Insurer Feedback Received
states.trigger: Insurance fund sends response via KIM
states.changes: Feedback message displayed: acceptance, rejection, or query. Action buttons for corrective response if needed.

states.name: Cancelled
states.trigger: eAU cancelled within 120-day window
states.changes: Strikethrough on the entry. Cancellation timestamp and reason shown.

states.name: Patient Copy
states.trigger: User selects patient copy
states.changes: Full eAU data shown including diagnosis codes and description. Barcode present.

states.name: Employer Copy
states.trigger: User selects employer copy
states.changes: Incapacity period and patient name shown. Diagnosis omitted. Barcode present.

components.name: Certificate Type Selector
components.description: Radio buttons or segmented control: Erstbescheinigung / Folgebescheinigung / Endbescheinigung.

components.name: Diagnosis Entry
components.description: ICD-10 code entry with search and auto-complete. Diagnosensicherheit (certainty) selector (G/V/Z/A). Can pull from patient's documented diagnoses.

components.name: Incapacity Period
components.description: Start date and expected end date pickers. Start date defaults to today for initial certificates.

components.name: Accident Indicator
components.description: Checkboxes for work accident (Arbeitsunfall), occupational disease (Berufskrankheit), or third-party injury (Versorgungsleiden). Reveals additional fields when checked.

components.name: Employer Data Section
components.description: Employer name and address fields. Populated from patient record if available. Used for employer copy generation.

components.name: eAU Status Row
components.description: A row per eAU showing: patient name, diagnosis (masked), incapacity period, transmission date, delivery status badge, and actions (view, cancel, retry).

components.name: Insurer Feedback Card
components.description: Card showing insurer response: acceptance, rejection with reason, or query with requested information. Action buttons for response.

components.name: Barcode
components.description: Barcode encoding the eAU reference for verification by insurers or employers.

surfaces.name: Doctor Letter Composer
surfaces.description: The authoring surface for creating an electronic doctor letter. Contains structured sections (diagnoses, findings, medications, therapy recommendations), recipient selection, and attachment management. Generates HL7 CDA R2 with embedded PDF/A.

surfaces.name: Letter Transmission Status
surfaces.description: Status view for sent and received eArztbriefe. Shows delivery status (DSN tracking), sent/received timestamps, and matched patient. Dual-purpose: outgoing tracking and incoming letter management.

surfaces.name: Incoming Letter Viewer
surfaces.description: Read-only viewer for received eArztbriefe. Displays the PDF/A rendering of the letter, parsed structured data, and patient matching results. Allows archiving to patient record.

states.name: Composing
states.trigger: User opens a new letter
states.changes: Empty sections for content entry. Recipient search field. Practice letterhead shown in header.

states.name: Recipient Selected
states.trigger: User selects a recipient physician
states.changes: Recipient name, specialty, and address shown. KIM address resolved and displayed. Multiple recipients supported.

states.name: Attachments Added
states.trigger: User attaches supplementary documents
states.changes: Attachment list below letter body: lab results, imaging, PDFs. Each attachment shows filename, type, and size.

states.name: Ready to Sign
states.trigger: All required sections completed
states.changes: "Sign & Send" button enabled. Preview of the PDF/A rendering available.

states.name: Outgoing — Delivered
states.trigger: DSN confirms delivery
states.changes: Green badge. Delivery timestamp. GOP 86900 auto-billed.

states.name: Outgoing — Failed
states.trigger: DSN reports failure
states.changes: Red badge. Error details. Retry action.

states.name: Incoming — Auto-Matched
states.trigger: Incoming letter matched to patient
states.changes: Patient name shown. "Review & Archive" action. GOP 86901 auto-billed.

states.name: Incoming — Unmatched
states.trigger: Incoming letter could not be matched
states.changes: Yellow badge. "Assign to Patient" action for manual matching.

states.name: Letter Content
states.trigger: User opens a received letter
states.changes: PDF/A rendering displayed. Parsed structured data shown in sidebar (diagnoses, medications, findings). Archive button.

components.name: Section Editor
components.description: Structured content sections: Diagnoses, Findings, Medications, Therapy Recommendations, Free Text. Each section supports both coded (ICD-10, medications from BMP) and narrative entry.

components.name: Recipient Search
components.description: Search for recipient by name, LANR, BSNR, or specialty. Resolves KIM address from directory. Supports multiple recipients.

components.name: Attachment Manager
components.description: List of attached documents with add/remove actions. Supports PDF, TIFF, JPEG, and structured clinical documents.

components.surface: Doctor Letter Composer, side panel or modal
components.name: PDF/A Preview
components.description: Preview of the generated PDF/A that will be embedded in the CDA document. Shows how the letter will appear to the recipient.

components.surface: Doctor Letter Composer, header; PDF/A output
components.name: Letterhead
components.description: Practice name, address, phone, fax, email, physician name. Auto-populated from practice settings.

components.name: Letter Status Row
components.description: A row per letter showing: direction (sent/received icon), patient name, recipient/sender, date, subject, status badge, and actions.

components.name: Patient Match Indicator
components.description: Shows the matched patient name and confidence level. For auto-matches, shows which identifiers matched (name, DOB, insurance number). For unmatched, shows a patient search field.

components.name: Structured Data Sidebar
components.description: Parsed data from the CDA document: diagnoses (ICD-10), medications, findings. Read-only. Can be imported into patient's record.

surfaces.name: ePA Document Browser
surfaces.description: A document management surface for browsing, uploading, and downloading documents from the patient's ePA. Shows a categorized list of documents with upload actions and retrieval capabilities.

surfaces.name: ePA Entitlement Manager
surfaces.description: A panel for managing the practice's access authorization to a patient's ePA. Shows current entitlement status, validity period, and request/renewal actions.

surfaces.name: Document Upload Dialog
surfaces.description: A dialog for selecting documents to upload to the ePA. Shows document type selection, PDF/A conversion status, and MIO profile validation.

states.name: ePA Active
states.trigger: Patient has an active ePA and practice has entitlement
states.changes: Document list loaded by category. Upload and download actions available.

states.name: No ePA
states.trigger: Patient has not activated an ePA
states.changes: Empty state: "Patient has no active ePA." No actions available.

states.name: No Entitlement
states.trigger: Practice lacks access authorization
states.changes: Locked state: "Access not authorized." Button to request entitlement.

states.name: Entitlement Expired
states.trigger: Access authorization has expired
states.changes: Yellow warning. Renewal action available. Previous entitlement dates shown.

states.name: Entitlement Active
states.trigger: Valid access authorization exists
states.changes: Green indicator. Validity period shown. Category-level restrictions displayed if patient has set any.

states.name: Entitlement Requested
states.trigger: Request sent, awaiting patient confirmation
states.changes: Blue "pending" indicator. Instructions for patient (confirm via eGK or insurance app).

states.name: Upload Ready
states.trigger: User selects documents for upload
states.changes: Document list with type selector per document. PDF/A conversion status shown (converted/already compliant/failed). MIO profile validation result.

states.name: Conversion in Progress
states.trigger: PDF/A conversion running
states.changes: Progress indicator per document being converted.

states.name: Upload Complete
states.trigger: All documents uploaded successfully
states.changes: Green confirmation per document. Close action.

states.name: Restricted Category
states.trigger: Patient has restricted a document category
states.changes: Category shown as locked/dimmed. Tooltip explains patient restriction.

components.name: Document Category List
components.description: Hierarchical list of document categories: eArztbrief, eAU, eMP, NFD, DPE, Lab Results, Imaging, etc. Shows document count per category.

components.name: Document Row
components.description: A row per document showing: title/type, date, author (physician/practice), MIO profile badge, and actions (download, view).

components.name: Upload Button
components.description: Opens the Document Upload Dialog. Enabled only when entitlement is active.

components.name: Download/View Action
components.description: Downloads the document to the local PVS or opens it in a viewer (PDF/A rendering for CDA documents, direct view for PDFs).

components.name: Entitlement Status Card
components.description: Shows current status: active (green), expired (yellow), none (red), pending (blue). Validity dates. Practice name and authorized physicians.

components.name: Request Entitlement Button
components.description: Initiates an access authorization request via the patient's eGK or Aktensystem.

components.name: Document Type Selector
components.description: Dropdown per document: eArztbrief, eAU, eMP, NFD, DPE, General Document. Determines the MIO profile used for validation.

components.surface: Document Upload Dialog, per document row
components.name: PDF/A Conversion Indicator
components.description: Shows conversion status: green check (already PDF/A compliant), blue spinner (converting), green check (converted), red X (conversion failed).

components.surface: Document Upload Dialog, per document row
components.name: MIO Validation Badge
components.description: Badge showing whether the document conforms to the required MIO profile: green (valid), red (invalid with details).

surfaces.name: eDMP Documentation Form
surfaces.description: The primary data entry surface for chronic disease management documentation. A dynamic form that adapts its field set based on the selected DMP program (8 programs). Contains disease-specific clinical fields, conditional logic, completeness indicators, and previous documentation values for reference.

surfaces.name: eDMP Patient Overview
surfaces.description: A dashboard showing a patient's DMP enrollment(s), documentation history, and upcoming documentation due dates. Entry point for creating new documentation or reviewing past entries.

surfaces.name: eDMP Validation Results
surfaces.description: A results panel shown after XPM validation. Displays errors (blocking) and warnings (non-blocking) with field-level references. Prevents submission until blocking errors are resolved.

states.name: Program Selected
states.trigger: User selects a DMP program (e.g., Diabetes Typ 2)
states.changes: Form fields change entirely to show the program-specific field set. Required fields marked. Conditional fields hidden until triggered.

states.name: Initial Documentation
states.trigger: First documentation for this patient in this program
states.changes: All fields empty. "Erstdokumentation" indicator shown. Additional enrollment-specific fields may appear.

states.name: Follow-Up Documentation
states.trigger: Subsequent documentation entry
states.changes: Previous documentation values shown in a reference column alongside current entry fields. Pre-populated fields marked distinctly (not auto-adopted, just displayed for reference).

states.name: Conditional Fields Visible
states.trigger: User enters a value that triggers dependent fields
states.changes: Additional fields appear below the triggering field with a visual connection (indentation or grouping).

states.name: Completeness OK
states.trigger: All mandatory fields filled with valid values
states.changes: Green indicator. "Validate & Submit" button enabled.

states.name: Incomplete
states.trigger: Mandatory fields missing or invalid
states.changes: Red indicator showing count of issues. Missing fields highlighted. "Validate & Submit" disabled or warns.

states.name: Validation Passed
states.trigger: XPM validation returns no blocking errors
states.changes: Green result. Submission can proceed. Non-blocking warnings listed if any.

states.name: Validation Failed
states.trigger: XPM validation returns blocking errors
states.changes: Red result. Error list with field references. Each error links back to the form field. Submission blocked.

states.name: Warnings Only
states.trigger: XPM returns warnings but no blocking errors
states.changes: Yellow result. Warning list shown. Doctor can override with documented justification. Submission allowed after override.

states.name: Multi-Program Enrolled
states.trigger: Patient enrolled in multiple DMP programs
states.changes: Multiple program cards shown (e.g., Diabetes + KHK). Each shows its own documentation status and due dates.

components.name: Program Selector
components.description: Selector for the DMP program. May be pre-selected from the patient's enrollment. Shows all programs the patient is enrolled in.

components.name: Clinical Field Group
components.description: A group of related clinical fields (e.g., "Blutdruck" group containing systolic + diastolic). Shows field label, input, unit, valid range, and required indicator.

components.surface: eDMP Documentation Form, beside current fields
components.name: Previous Value Column
components.description: Shows the last documented value for each field. Displayed as read-only reference. Helps the doctor see trends and changes.

components.surface: eDMP Documentation Form, header or footer
components.name: Completeness Indicator
components.description: Shows progress: "X of Y required fields completed." Color-coded (red → yellow → green).

components.name: Conditional Field Trigger
components.description: When a field value triggers conditional fields, a visual connector (indent, bracket, or animation) shows the relationship.

components.name: DMP Program Card
components.description: Card per enrolled program showing: program name, enrollment date, last documentation date, next due date, documentation count, status badge.

components.name: Documentation Timeline
components.description: Chronological list of all past documentation entries for a program. Each entry shows date, key values, and a "View" action.

components.name: Validation Error Row
components.description: A row per error/warning showing: severity icon, field name, error description, and a "Go to field" link.

components.name: Override Justification
components.description: Text field for documenting why the doctor is overriding a non-blocking warning. Required before submission can proceed.

entries.phaseName: User Stories — eDocumentation eHKS (Skin Cancer Screening)

surfaces.name: eHKS Documentation Form
surfaces.description: A structured form for documenting skin cancer screening findings. Contains eligibility check, examination findings per body region, suspicious lesion details, dermoscopy, referral, and biopsy tracking.

states.name: Eligibility Check
states.trigger: Form opened for a patient
states.changes: Eligibility indicator: green if patient is >= 35 and insured, red if ineligible. Ineligible patients cannot proceed.

states.name: Initial Screening
states.trigger: User selects "Initial screening" type
states.changes: Standard examination fields displayed. All body regions available for documentation.

states.name: Follow-Up Screening
states.trigger: User selects "Follow-up screening"
states.changes: Previous screening findings shown for reference. Focus on previously suspicious regions.

states.name: No Suspicious Findings
states.trigger: All body regions documented with normal findings
states.changes: Clean summary. No referral or biopsy sections triggered. Ready for submission.

states.name: Suspicious Findings
states.trigger: User documents a suspicious lesion
states.changes: Lesion detail fields expand: location, size, characteristics, dermoscopy findings. Referral to dermatologist field appears (if GP-initiated). Biopsy recommendation field appears.

states.name: GP-Initiated
states.trigger: Screening performed by GP
states.changes: Referral-to-dermatologist section available if suspicious findings documented.

states.name: Dermatologist-Initiated
states.trigger: Screening performed by dermatologist
states.changes: Biopsy section directly available. No referral section (already at specialist).

components.name: Eligibility Badge
components.description: Shows patient age and eligibility status. Green badge for eligible, red for ineligible with reason.

components.name: Screening Type Selector
components.description: Radio buttons: Initial / Follow-up. Determines which fields and references are shown.

components.name: Body Region Checklist
components.description: Structured checklist of body regions (head/neck, trunk, upper extremities, lower extremities, etc.). Each region has a findings field: normal / suspicious / not examined.

components.surface: eHKS Documentation Form, below body region
components.name: Lesion Detail Card
components.description: Expandable card per suspicious lesion: location (body map or text), size (mm), color/shape characteristics, dermoscopy findings (if performed).

components.name: Dermoscopy Section
components.description: Fields for dermoscopy findings: pattern, structures observed, clinical impression. Only shown when dermoscopy was performed.

components.name: Referral Indicator
components.description: For GP screenings with suspicious findings: referral-to-dermatologist field with specialist name and urgency.

components.name: Biopsy Tracker
components.description: Fields for biopsy recommendation, biopsy date, and result tracking. Tracks whether recommended biopsy was performed and its outcome.

components.name: GOP Code Display
components.description: Shows the applicable screening GOP (01745 for GP, 01746 for dermatologist). Auto-assigned to the billing case.

surfaces.name: Scoring Calculator Panel
surfaces.description: An embedded panel within eDMP documentation forms for clinical scoring tools (PHQ-9, DAS-28). Shows the questionnaire items, auto-calculates the total score, and displays severity classification. Tracks score history for trend visualization.

surfaces.name: Audit Trail Viewer
surfaces.description: A read-only viewer showing the complete modification history of a patient's clinical documentation. Displays who changed what, when, with original and new values. Used for compliance review and legal audits.

states.name: PHQ-9 Active
states.trigger: Doctor opens PHQ-9 calculator (from Depression DMP)
states.changes: 9 questionnaire items displayed. Each item has a 4-option scale (0-3). Total auto-calculated. Severity classification shown.

states.name: DAS-28 Active
states.trigger: Doctor opens DAS-28 calculator
states.changes: 28-joint tenderness/swelling grid, ESR or CRP input, patient VAS input. Composite score auto-calculated. Activity classification shown.

states.name: Score History
states.trigger: Previous scores exist for this patient
states.changes: Historical score chart or table shown alongside current entry. Trend line visible (improving, stable, worsening).

states.name: No History
states.trigger: First time using this score for the patient
states.changes: Empty history. Only current entry fields shown.

states.name: Document Selected
states.trigger: User selects a documentation entry to audit
states.changes: Full modification history for that entry: creation timestamp/user, all subsequent edits with before/after values, any deletions (marked, not removed).

states.name: Export Mode
states.trigger: User requests audit trail export
states.changes: Export dialog with date range, document type filters, and format selection (PDF, CSV).

components.name: Questionnaire Item Row
components.description: A row per PHQ-9 item showing the question text and a 4-option selector (Not at all / Several days / More than half / Nearly every day). Score value shown per selection.

components.name: Joint Assessment Grid
components.description: A visual or tabular 28-joint grid where the doctor marks tenderness and swelling per joint.

components.name: Score Display
components.description: Shows the calculated total score in large text, severity classification with color coding, and a "Save to Documentation" action.

components.surface: Scoring Calculator Panel, beside score display
components.name: Trend Chart
components.description: A small line chart showing prior score values over time. X-axis: dates. Y-axis: score. Color bands for severity zones.

components.name: Audit Entry Row
components.description: A row per modification showing: timestamp, user name, field changed, original value, new value, and action type (create/modify/delete).

components.name: Deletion Marker
components.description: For deleted entries: shows the original content with strikethrough, deletion timestamp, deleting user, and deletion reason. Content preserved, not removed.

components.name: Export Button
components.description: Triggers export of the audit trail with filters for date range and document type.

surfaces.name: eDMP/eDoc Submission Dashboard
surfaces.description: A practice-wide dashboard for managing quarterly submission of all eDMP and eDocumentation data to the KV. Shows all pending documentation, batch validation status, and transmission progress. Consolidates individual patient submissions into a quarterly workflow.

states.name: Quarter Overview
states.trigger: User opens the dashboard
states.changes: Summary cards: total eDMP documentation count by program, eHKS count, validation status (passed/pending/failed), and submission status (unsent/sent/delivered).

states.name: Batch Validation Running
states.trigger: User triggers batch XPM validation
states.changes: Progress indicator. Results accumulate as each document is validated. Error count updates in real-time.

states.name: Batch Validation Complete
states.trigger: All documents validated
states.changes: Summary: X passed, Y failed, Z warnings. Failed items listed with patient name and error type. Each item links to the documentation form for correction.

states.name: Batch Submission in Progress
states.trigger: User triggers batch KIM submission
states.changes: Progress indicator showing: X of Y transmitted. Per-document status updates as DSNs arrive.

states.name: All Delivered
states.trigger: All transmissions confirmed via DSN
states.changes: Green overall status. Full delivery log available.

states.name: Partial Failures
states.trigger: Some transmissions failed
states.changes: Mixed status: green for delivered, red for failed. Failed items have retry and individual re-transmit actions.

states.name: Correction Mode
states.trigger: Previously submitted documentation needs correction
states.changes: Orange items marked for correction. "Re-validate & Re-submit" action per item. Re-submission replaces the previous version at the KV.

components.name: Program Summary Card
components.description: One card per DMP program showing: total documentation count for the quarter, validated count, submitted count, and delivered count. Color-coded status.

components.name: eHKS Summary Card
components.description: Shows eHKS documentation count with validation and submission status. Same layout as program cards.

components.name: Pending Items List
components.description: A filterable list of all documentation awaiting validation or submission. Each row: patient name, program type, documentation date, validation status, submission status, and actions (validate, submit, view, correct).

components.name: Batch Action Toolbar
components.description: Buttons for: "Validate All," "Submit All Validated," "Retry Failed." Applies to all items matching the current filter.

components.name: Transmission Log
components.description: Chronological log of all KIM transmissions: timestamp, document reference, recipient KV, status (sent/delivered/failed), and DSN details.

components.name: Validation Error Summary
components.description: Aggregated view of validation errors across all documents. Grouped by error type. Shows count per error and affected patients.

entries.phaseName: User Stories — System Integrity & Date Controls

surfaces.name: System Status Bar
surfaces.description: A persistent status bar (header or footer region) visible across the application showing the current system date/time, logged-in user, and active practice location. Serves as the authoritative date reference for all data entry and validation.

states.name: Normal
states.trigger: System clock is valid and synchronized
states.changes: Date/time displayed in standard format. No warnings.

states.name: Clock Discrepancy Warning
states.trigger: System detects potential clock issues (e.g., OS date far in the past)
states.changes: Warning indicator beside the date. Tooltip explains the issue. Non-dismissible until resolved at OS level.

components.surface: All date entry fields throughout the application
components.name: Date Input Validator
components.description: A shared date input component that validates calendar correctness (no Feb 30, no month 13) and rejects invalid dates immediately with an inline error message.

components.surface: GNR and ICD-10-GM code entry fields (Phases 2A, 2B)
components.name: Forward-Date Guard
components.description: An inline validation that prevents saving any GNR or ICD-10-GM code with a date beyond the current system date. Shows error: "Date cannot be in the future."

components.surface: All mandatory fields with defined replacement values
components.name: Mandatory Field Default Confirmation
components.description: When a replacement/default value exists for a mandatory field, the field is shown empty with a subtle indicator (e.g., ghost text showing the default). The user must explicitly confirm to apply the default; it is never auto-populated.

components.name: System Date Display
components.description: Shows the OS-provided system date and time. No override mechanism exists in the application. Read-only, derived from OS clock.

surfaces.name: Practice Administration Panel
surfaces.description: The central admin surface for managing practice locations (BSNR) and their assigned physicians (LANR). Shows all locations with their physicians, supports adding/editing locations and physician assignments, and controls billing file generation mode (per-location or consolidated).
surfaces.capabilities: Location management, physician assignment, billing mode

surfaces.name: User & Rights Management Panel
surfaces.description: Admin surface for managing user accounts, roles, and permissions. Each user is linked to a LANR and one or more practice locations. Supports role-based access control so that billed services are traceable to the performing physician and location.
surfaces.capabilities: User accounts, role assignment, LANR binding

states.name: Single Location
states.trigger: Practice has only one BSNR
states.changes: Simplified view: one location card with its physician list. No billing mode selector (per-location is the only option).

states.name: Multi-Location
states.trigger: Practice has multiple BSNRs
states.changes: Multiple location cards displayed. Billing mode selector appears: "Per-location" (default) or "Consolidated." Each location shows its physician roster.

states.name: Consolidated Billing Enabled
states.trigger: Admin selects consolidated billing mode
states.changes: Visual indicator showing all locations will produce a single combined billing file. Warning: all BSNRs and LANRs must be in the besa dataset. Validation check shown.

states.name: Pseudo-LANR in Use
states.trigger: A user is assigned the pseudo-LANR 999999900
states.changes: The pseudo-LANR is displayed with a distinct badge ("Pseudo") and explanation text. Used for locum, emergency, or unattributable services.

states.name: Duplicate LANR Warning
states.trigger: Admin attempts to assign the same LANR to the same BSNR twice
states.changes: Inline error preventing the duplicate assignment. Message: "This LANR is already assigned to this location."

components.name: Location Card
components.description: A card per practice location showing: BSNR, location name/address, list of assigned physicians (LANR + name), and an "Edit" action. Color-coded status indicator for billing readiness.

components.name: Physician Assignment Row
components.description: A row per physician showing: name, LANR, specialty, active/inactive status. Actions: remove from location, edit. The pseudo-LANR 999999900 row is visually distinguished.

components.name: Add Physician Action
components.description: Button to assign an existing user (by LANR) to this location, or to create a new user and assign simultaneously. Validates LANR uniqueness per BSNR before saving.

components.name: Billing Mode Selector
components.description: Toggle or radio: "Per-location billing" (default, one file per BSNR) or "Consolidated billing" (single file, all BSNRs). Only shown for multi-location practices.

components.name: User Account Row
components.description: A row per user showing: name, LANR, assigned locations (BSNR list), role, and permissions summary. Actions: edit, deactivate.

components.surface: User & Rights Management Panel, edit mode
components.name: Role & Permissions Editor
components.description: Form for assigning roles (physician, MFA, admin, etc.) and granular permissions. Links the user to their LANR and one or more practice locations.

components.name: BSNR Billing File Preview
components.description: Shows which billing files will be generated based on current configuration. Lists each file with its BSNR-derived filename. In consolidated mode, shows a single file with all BSNRs listed.

surfaces.name: TI Connector Status Panel
surfaces.description: An admin panel showing the practice's TI connector information: product name, firmware/product type version, certificate expiry date, and supported TI applications (ePA, eRezept, KIM, etc.). All data is read from the connector and displayed for the admin. This information is also automatically embedded in ADT billing files.
surfaces.capabilities: Connector info display, certificate monitoring, TI attestation

states.name: Connected
states.trigger: Connector is reachable and responding
states.changes: All fields populated: product name, version, certificate expiry, supported applications. Green connection indicator.

states.name: Certificate Expiring Soon
states.trigger: Certificate expiry date is within 90 days (configurable threshold)
states.changes: Certificate expiry field highlighted in yellow/orange with warning text: "Certificate expires on [date]. Contact your TI service provider."

states.name: Certificate Expired
states.trigger: Certificate expiry date has passed
states.changes: Certificate expiry field highlighted in red. Warning: "Certificate expired. TI services may be unavailable."

states.name: Connector Unreachable
states.trigger: Connector cannot be contacted
states.changes: All fields show "Unavailable" or last known values with a stale-data indicator. Red connection indicator with troubleshooting hint.

components.name: Connector Identity Card
components.description: Shows connector product name (FK 0228) and ProductTypeVersion (FK 0224) in a card layout. Read-only, auto-populated from connector.

components.name: Certificate Expiry Display
components.description: Shows the connector certificate expiry date (FK 0227) with color-coded urgency: green (>90 days), yellow (30-90 days), red (<30 days or expired).

components.name: TI Application Checklist
components.description: A checklist of TI specialist applications with their support status. Each row: application name (ePA, eRezept, KIM, etc.), supported (green check) or not supported (gray dash). This attestation data is transmitted in the ADT billing.

components.name: Billing Inclusion Indicator
components.description: A subtle note confirming: "This information is automatically included in ADT billing files (FK 0224, FK 0227, FK 0228)." Reassures the admin that no manual action is needed for billing transmission.

entries.phaseName: User Stories — KBV Master Data Files

surfaces.name: Master Data Management Panel
surfaces.description: A central admin surface for viewing and managing all KBV master data files (SDKT, SDKV, SDAV, PLZ, SDEBM). Shows each dataset's current version, deployment status, last update date, and validity period. Entry point for importing new quarterly updates and browsing dataset contents.
surfaces.capabilities: Quarterly deployment, version tracking, dataset browsing

surfaces.name: Fee Schedule Browser
surfaces.description: A searchable, browsable view of the EBM fee schedule (SDEBM). Shows all GOPs with point values, validation rules, and regional overrides. Supports user extensions (custom GOPs) and clearly distinguishes official EBM entries from user-added ones. Regional KV-specific entries take priority over federal fallback.
surfaces.capabilities: GOP lookup, user extensions, regional priority

states.name: All Current
states.trigger: All datasets are deployed with current quarterly versions
states.changes: Green status badges on all dataset cards. No action required.

states.name: Update Available
states.trigger: A new quarterly version of one or more datasets is available but not yet deployed
states.changes: Yellow badge on affected dataset(s). "Import Update" action highlighted. Warning if quarter has already started.

states.name: Update Overdue
states.trigger: Quarter has started but one or more datasets are still on the previous quarter's version
states.changes: Red badge on affected dataset(s). Blocking warning: "Outdated [dataset] may cause billing errors."

states.name: Import in Progress
states.trigger: Admin has triggered a dataset import
states.changes: Progress indicator on the importing dataset card. Other datasets remain accessible.

states.name: SDKT with Temporary Entries
states.trigger: User or vendor has added temporary cost carrier entries
states.changes: SDKT card shows count of temporary entries. "Review Temporary Entries" action available.

states.name: Regional EBM Active
states.trigger: Practice's KV region has a regional SDEBM version
states.changes: Regional entries shown as primary, with a subtle indicator. Federal fallback entries shown where no regional override exists. Filter toggle: "Show regional only" / "Show all."

states.name: User Extensions Present
states.trigger: User has added or modified GOPs
states.changes: User-added/modified entries shown with a distinct badge ("Custom"). Filter toggle: "Show custom only."

states.name: EBM Update Changelog
states.trigger: Quarterly SDEBM update has been applied
states.changes: Changelog panel showing added, removed, and changed GOPs since last quarter. Affected existing documentation flagged.

components.name: Dataset Card
