components.description: One card per master data file (SDKT, SDKV, SDAV, PLZ, SDEBM). Shows: dataset name, current version, deployment date, validity period, record count, and status badge. Actions: "Import Update," "Browse Contents."

components.name: Import Action
components.description: Button to import a new quarterly version of the dataset. Shows import progress and validation results. For SDKT: reconciles temporary entries against the new official data.

components.name: Temporary Entry Indicator
components.description: Badge showing count of temporary cost carrier entries. Links to a filtered view of temporary records. Entries are marked for reconciliation on next official import.

components.surface: Master Data Management Panel, SDKT browse view
components.name: Cost Carrier Record Row
components.description: A row per cost carrier showing: VKNR, IK, name, and edit status. Official fields are read-only (locked icon). Temporary entries have a distinct visual treatment. gematik test payer (VKNR 74799) shown with "Excluded from billing" tag.

components.name: GOP Row
components.description: A row per GOP showing: code, description, point value, validity period, regional indicator, and source (official / custom). Official entries are read-only except where user extension is permitted.

components.name: Add Custom GOP Action
components.description: Button to add a user-defined GOP. Opens a form with code, description, point value, and validity fields. The custom entry is tagged distinctly from official EBM entries.

components.name: Regional Priority Indicator
components.description: A small badge or icon showing whether a GOP comes from the regional KV-specific SDEBM (primary) or the federal fallback.

components.name: Update Changelog
components.description: Shows a diff of GOPs between the previous and current SDEBM version: new codes (green), removed codes (red), modified rules (yellow). Links to affected documentation.

components.surface: Fee Schedule Browser, on modified documentation
components.name: Undo/Rollback Action
components.description: For service documentation entries that were changed by EBM validation rules or manual edits: an "Undo" action that reverts to the previous state.

surfaces.name: Module Management Panel
surfaces.description: An admin panel for managing the XPM (validation module) and XKM (crypto module). Shows current module versions, deployment status, and update availability. Provides import/update actions and a processing pipeline view showing the billing file workflow: validate → attach communication record → encrypt.
surfaces.capabilities: Module deployment, version tracking, pipeline visualization

surfaces.name: System Compliance Settings
surfaces.description: A settings panel for system-wide compliance parameters: AMV certification number (FK 9250), ICD-10-GM version status, and form printing catalog version. These are rarely changed but must be accessible and correctly transmitted in billing data.

states.name: Modules Current
states.trigger: XPM and XKM are on the current quarterly version
states.changes: Green badges. Pipeline visualization shows normal flow.

states.name: Module Update Available
states.trigger: A newer version of XPM or XKM is available
states.changes: Yellow badge on the affected module. "Update" action highlighted.

states.name: Standalone XPM Mode
states.trigger: Practice uses standalone XPM instead of integrated
states.changes: Pipeline visualization shows the XPM step as external. An "Export Unencrypted File" action is available for the standalone XPM to process.

states.name: Integrated Mode
states.trigger: XPM is integrated into the PVS (default)
states.changes: Pipeline runs automatically: validate → append communication record → encrypt. No manual file export needed.

states.name: AMV Certified
states.trigger: AMV certification number is entered
states.changes: Green badge beside the AMV field. Certification number shown with FK 9250 field reference.

states.name: AMV Not Configured
states.trigger: No AMV certification number entered
states.changes: Yellow warning: "AMV certification number required for billing (FK 9250)." Input field highlighted.

components.name: Module Card
components.description: One card per module (XPM, XKM). Shows: module name, current version, last update date, and status badge. Actions: "Update," "View Details."

components.name: Processing Pipeline Diagram
components.description: A visual flow diagram showing the billing file processing sequence: (1) Generate KVDT file → (2) XPM validation → (3) Append communication record → (4) XKM encryption → (5) Ready for transmission. Each step shows its current status.

components.name: Export Unencrypted File Action
components.description: A button to export the raw, unvalidated, unencrypted KVDT billing file for processing by a standalone XPM. Only visible when standalone mode is active.

components.name: AMV Certification Field
components.description: Input field for the KBV AMV certification number. Stored persistently and transmitted in FK 9250 of every billing file.

components.name: ICD-10-GM Version Display
components.description: Shows the currently active ICD-10-GM version (annual release). Read-only, derived from the deployed ICD catalog. Status indicator: green if current year's version is active.

components.name: Form Printing Catalog Status
components.description: Shows compliance with the KBV form printing requirements catalog. Read-only status indicator confirming that form printing follows the mandatory specification.

components.name: Fee Schedule Auto-Population Indicator
components.description: Confirms that fee schedule (FK 4121) is automatically pre-populated from the cost carrier master data (SDKT). Shows the lookup logic: patient insurance → SDKT → fee schedule code.

surfaces.name: HZV/FAV Contract Management Panel
surfaces.description: The central admin surface for configuring and managing selective contracts (HZV and FaV). Shows all available contracts, active contracts, contract IDs, fee schedule appendices, and cost carrier mappings. Entry point for contract activation, configuration, and document access.
surfaces.capabilities: Contract setup, fee schedules, cost carrier mapping

surfaces.name: Physician Identity Management Panel
surfaces.description: Admin surface for managing physician identifiers used in HZV/FAV contracts: HÄVG-ID, MEDIVERBUND-ID, and VP-ID. Shows each physician's identifiers with migration status (legacy ID → VP-ID). Supports automatic VP-ID retrieval from the HPM API.

surfaces.name: Contract Documents Viewer
surfaces.description: A read-only viewer for accessing public contract documents (Vertragstexte, Dokumente). Provides view and print actions for locally available documents and links to external portals (HÄVG, MEDIVERBUND, Hausärzteverband) for online access.

states.name: Contract Activation — Step 1
states.trigger: Admin initiates contract activation for a physician
states.changes: Filtered list showing only contracts valid for the practice's KV region (from BSNR) and currently active. No user action required to filter.

states.name: Contract Activation — Step 2
states.trigger: Admin explicitly requests to see all contracts
states.changes: Full list of all contracts from the contract overview appendices, including those outside the practice's KV region or expired.

states.name: Contract Active
states.trigger: A contract is activated and configured
states.changes: Contract card shows: contract ID, fee schedule appendices, cost carrier tree, participation status, and document links. All workflows (enrollment, billing, data transmission) are enabled.

states.name: VP-ID Available
states.trigger: Physician has a VP-ID stored
states.changes: VP-ID displayed as primary identifier. Legacy ID (HÄVG-ID or MEDIVERBUND-ID) shown as secondary with "Migrated" badge.

states.name: VP-ID Missing
states.trigger: Physician has legacy ID but no VP-ID
states.changes: Yellow warning: "VP-ID not yet retrieved." "Retrieve VP-ID" action button visible. Legacy ID shown as primary.

states.name: VP-ID Retrieval in Progress
states.trigger: Admin triggers VP-ID retrieval
states.changes: Loading indicator on the physician's row. Upon success, VP-ID populates and badge changes to "Migrated."

states.name: Participation Return Data
states.trigger: System fetches participation data from HPM API
states.changes: Informational display of participation status. Prominent notice: "For information only. Changes require written HÄVG confirmation." No automated actions triggered.

states.name: HZV Documents
states.trigger: User views HZV contract documents
states.changes: Public contract texts and documents shown with view/print actions. Link to HÄVG portal for online access.

states.name: FaV Documents
states.trigger: User views FaV contract documents
states.changes: Public contract texts shown. Link to MEDIVERBUND portal (medi-verbund.de/facharztvertraege/).

states.name: AWH_01 Documents
states.trigger: User views AWH_01 contract documents
states.changes: Notice directing user to the Hausärzteverband website for contract texts.

components.name: Contract Card
components.description: One card per active contract showing: contract ID (ALLG661), contract type (HZV/FaV), KV region, validity period, fee schedule appendices, and cost carrier summary. Actions: configure, view documents, deactivate.

components.name: Contract Activation Wizard
components.description: Two-step flow: Step 1 shows region-filtered contracts (automatic). Step 2 (explicit action) shows all contracts. Guides admin through activating a contract for a physician.

components.name: Fee Schedule Appendix List
components.description: Lists the fee schedule appendices (Honoraranlagen) for the contract. Each appendix shows its name and the service codes it covers.

components.name: Cost Carrier Tree
components.description: Hierarchical view of cost carriers covered by the contract: main funds (Hauptkassen) → individual funds (Kassen), each with IK numbers. Parsed from the contract XML.

components.name: Participation Status Display
components.description: Shows participation return data from the HPM API. Read-only, informational only. Includes the mandatory notice about requiring written HÄVG confirmation before making changes.

components.name: Physician Identity Row
components.description: One row per physician showing: name, LANR, HÄVG-ID (HZV), MEDIVERBUND-ID (FaV), VP-ID (H-type, F-type, B-type), and migration status. Actions: "Retrieve VP-ID."

components.name: VP-ID Retrieval Action
components.description: Button that calls the HPM API to retrieve the VP-ID from the legacy ID. Shows progress and result. One-time action per physician per ID type.

components.name: Document List
components.description: List of public contract documents with: document name, type (Vertragstexte/Dokumente), and actions (view, print). Non-public documents are not shown.

components.name: External Portal Link
components.description: Links to external portals for online document access: HÄVG (HZV), MEDIVERBUND (FaV), Hausärzteverband (AWH_01).

components.surface: Contract Documents Viewer or Help section
components.name: Change Documentation Panel
components.description: Displays the changelog for the current software version: new features, changed features, removed features since the previous quarterly update.
